row.short_description: Try to escape from the Forest as you setup camp, then realize you were locked in there by a Park officer. There were 5 keyholes, so you had to find one key for each one.
row.notes: This game contains jumpscares and horror. Do not play if you have Isolophobia, Xylophobia, Nyctophobia or Teraphobia.

row.name: Undawn
row.detailed_description: Join Our Discord About the Game Explore, adapt, and survive in Undawn, a free-to-play open-world survival RPG for mobile and PC developed by LightSpeed Studios and published by Level Infinite. Embark on an adventure with other survivors four years after a worldwide disaster where hordes of infected roam a shattered world. Undawn combines PvP and PvE modes as players fend off dual threats of the infected and other humans as they fight to survive in this apocalyptic wasteland. SURVIVE YOUR WAY Become the ultimate endurance expert. Protect your home, allies, and what's left of humanity against overwhelming odds. The seamless open world of Undawn is filled with realistic details, made using Unreal Engine 4. In this world, players must brave rain, heat, snow, and storms and track their character’s survival indicators such as Hunger, Body Type, Vigor, Health, Hydration, and even Mood. Changes in the environment will also affect these survival indicators in real time. Players can customize their character’s appearance and outfits, interact with other players to trade weapons and resources, and fight to protect their resources. EXPLORE AN EXPANSIVE OPEN WORLD Dare to explore a huge seamless map filled with distinct terrains such as plains, mines, deserts, swamps, and abandoned cities, each with diverse ecosystems filled with animals, plants, and weather systems. While exploring the remains of society, players can discover special game modes through interactive environmental items, embattled strongholds, and dynamic weekly events and side quests. Players must bravely explore the continent, learning to craft tools, master different weapons, build a shelter, search for survival buddies, and do everything they can to stay alive. The infected can appear anytime as you are exploring and are a huge threat to your continued existence! REBUILD THE RUINS Rebuild a new home and a new civilization with the wisdom of humanity – build your base of operations to your specifications and survive on your own or with your friends inside a massive 1-acre manor. The robust free building system allows more than 1,000 types and styles of furniture and structures, as well as ways to grow your settlement over time. Search for other outposts to form alliances and fight back against the infected together to keep your home safe. SQUAD UP TO SURVIVE Set yourself up for success as a member of the storied Raven Squad. The raven is traditionally a symbol of death and bad omens but can also stand for prophecy and insight. Your squad lives between these two meanings each day and night. In the new world, four years after the disaster, survivors have split into different factions, each with their own rules of survival. Face off against members of the Clowns, Eagles, Night Owls, and Reivers for territory, and get through some darkest nights for the next sunrise. ARM YOURSELF FOR THE APOCALYPSE Protect your home, allies, and what's left of humanity against all odds with a wide variety of weapons and armor for you and your homebase. Beyond the standard weapons, players can also use other tactical gear including melee weapons, drones, decoy bombs, auto turrets and more to level the playing field. Choose from more than 50 types of vehicles for quick supply runs and to conquer new lands, while utilizing tailored-to-environment tactics to dominate the various infected zones found throughout the game.
row.short_description: Explore, adapt, and survive in Undawn, a free-to-play open-world survival RPG for mobile and PC developed by LightSpeed Studios and published by Level Infinite. Embark on an adventure with other survivors four years after a worldwide disaster where hordes of infected roam a shattered world.
row.notes: Undawn will include mild violence as players will be fighting mutants and other fractions throughout the game. Player will be using firearms and melee weapons to fight against enemies, but gore or close up scenes are not available in the game.

row.name: CatNab
row.detailed_description: What is CatNab? CatNab is a short, pick up and play game where you collect cats under a time limit. In a world where furry creatures roam the realms of plains, forests, and in this section of suburbia... there stands one cat nabbing crusader ready to bring them all home. Step into your shoes, Cat Nabber , and fulfill your destiny . What do the critics think? - 'Meow', 2022 - ' Meow, but italicized ', 2022 FEATURING Cats of various flavors and persuasions Leaderboards Stat allocation More cats than your SCREEN HAS ROOM FOR Simple Controls
row.short_description: The cat's outta the bag! That's why we're bringing a barrel. Compete for high scores by nabbing as many cats as you can.

row.name: Ella - a study in realism
row.detailed_description: Ella, a study in realism made in Godot Engine. Basically a technology showcase for Godot, you can watch it for a few minutes and look at the graphics and performance on your computer. A frames per second monitor is included (press Escape to open the menu) and you can also tweak the many graphics options. It includes 4 presets (Ultra, Quality, Performance, and Low Spec) and also allows you to change individual settings (for example, full screen mode or changing the render scaling, as well as visual settings like reflection and ambient occlusion). The experience features a cinematic camera that runs and loops by itself, so can be watched as a real time music video, a 3D graphics benchmark, or control the camera and fly around the environment. You can press the Space Bar to enable the camera control. The free camera control is like a spectator camera in games (with collision detection) and allows you to fly around freely and explore the environment and the graphics. Uses global illumination in Godot to achieve realistic lighting and shadow, all in real time (no baked lightmaps). The character model and some assets were made with photogrammetry for the highest possible quality. Press Escape to view the options. Space to toggle cinematic camera (be sure to close the menu before flying around). WASD or Arrow keys move around. Mouse to look.
row.short_description: Ella, a study in realism

row.name: The Winter
row.detailed_description: The Winter is an indie 2D computer game. You have to get into 2001 and play as not the most beautiful main character - Rustam and aimlessly explore the city of Karaganda. Yes, we are used to doing something meaningful, chasing the future and our goals, but in The Winter there is no need to rush anywhere: there is no plot and goals, just enjoy the moment and atmosphere. Feel the real!
row.short_description: Little platformer

row.name: Cluck
row.detailed_description: Do you miss the old simple fps games? Well we got you! Cluck is all about extremely fast phase shooting. So expect to die a lot! Unless you're a god of course. Spawn with only a pistol and get those pickups. These pickups are all around the map waiting to get picked up. Pickup armor, health, weapons ammo and get some kills. We can't forget the ultimate pickups though, the quack. Giving you 4x the damage, wrecking your opponents. Or pickup the Speed, making you faster at everything, including fire rate to shred your enemies. There's also jump pads you can use to get to your destination, the same goes for the portals. Be careful to not be on the other side of that portal for too long, as you can shoot grenades through the portals! Master the bunnyhopping and fly through your enemies with high speed, making you speeding around the map! If you're close enough to an enemy, punch them with your weapon for a quick kill and call out their humiliation. Remember to punch with your rocket launcher if you're too close to an opponent, as you don't want to kill yourself at the same time. Customization Customize your character with the in-game currency you get by playing the game itself. Get new colors, patches, face expressions, hats, and more! New updates will also come with even more customization options for you! Weapons 10 weapons are in this game. No need to stop and interact with the weapons and items you want to pick up though, just run over everything you see. Lets keep this simple, fun and fast-paced! Join our Discord!
row.short_description: Cluck is an extremely fast-paced fps arena shooter. Spawn with only a pistol and find weapons, armor, health and powerups such as the Quack and Speed along the map. Jump pads and portals are also around the map, enabling you to get to your destination. And customize your own chicken!

row.name: CycloHex
row.detailed_description: CycloHex is a twist on the classic board game Hex. The board has no 'edges' and going too far in one direction loops you to the other side like a PacMan level. The goal is to make a cycle that loops you though your color's edge and back to where you started before your opponent can. Despite it's simple rules, there's a world of strategy in CycloHex and countless ways to out-think your opponent! Play against your friends locally or online, or take on the built-in AI!
row.short_description: CycloHex is a twist on the classic board game Hex. Despite it's simple rules, there's a world of strategy in CycloHex and countless ways to out-think your opponent! Play against your friends locally or online, or take on the built-in AI!

row.name: 安特卫普的尼洛 Nello in Antwerp

row.name: Bout
row.detailed_description: Arrows appear on screen and players must tap the arrows as quickly as possible. The player with the most arrows correctly pressed at the end of the round wins. Up to four players can compete to see who is the fastest. The green flashes mean a correct input was pressed and a red flash means an incorrect input was pressed. Local play is live for players to play couch co-op or use Steam remote play together. Available modes are 2 players, 3 players, and 4 players local. Keyboard and most gamepads currently work in battle.
row.short_description: Tap in the arrows on the screen as fast as possible to win.

row.name: Weird Hat Fight
row.detailed_description: Do you like hats? Magic? Fighting your friends to the death? Well Weird Hat Fight is the Party Game for you! Pick a hat! Send your friends flying! Start an impromptu dance party! Grab your friends, jump into the arena, and claim victory in Weird Hat Fight! Features: * 4 Levels! * 5 Hats! * 2-4 Players Local Multiplayer! * Play Online using Steam Remoteplay Together!
row.short_description: Weird Hat Fight is a party game where you use magical hats to fight your friends to the death.

row.name: Tulips & Windmills
row.detailed_description: Tulips & Windmills is a charming and lighthearted clicker/idle game that immerses you in the iconic Dutch culture! 🌷✨ Grow your tulip empire as you upgrade your windmill, cultivate vast tulip fields, and unlock the true potential of the Netherlands' most beloved exports. Choose between manually harvesting tulips or hiring skilled gardeners to do the work for you. Join our Discord server to help design the game further and stay updated. The link is on the right! You start with a manual multiplier but get ready for much more! From autoclicker speed and effectiveness over fields and gardener upgrades, make sure to spend your tulips wisely! At some point, your automation may exceed your manual labor skills, watch your empire flourish while silently expanding and upgrading. See your progress as the tulip fields in the background get populated. Gardeners will help you harvest your fields, they become quicker and quicker! I promise! They will speed to your fields. Boost your production with unique Dutch-themed events like King’s Day or brave the infamous Kut Weer! (bad weather) to turn challenges into opportunities. Upgrade your windmill to increase its speed and efficiency, and watch your tulip fields flourish with ever-growing profits. With every decision, you’ll get one step closer to creating the ultimate Dutch tulip dynasty! Multipliers:  Upgrade your windmill and tulip fields to maximize profits and speed. Dutch Events:  Celebrate King’s Day, endure bad weather, or embrace the holiday spirit with Sinterklaas. Up for a challenge?  Change the language to Dutch and see if you can still find all the buttons. Steam Achievements:  Unlock fun and unique milestones as you grow your tulip empire. Save or Reset:  Choose to save your progress and continue where you left off before or reset your progress and start from the beginning. Supports Steam Cloud Saves . Whether you're a fan of idle games or just want to bask in the cheerful and vibrant world of tulips and windmills, Tulips & Windmills is the perfect game to spend time and enjoy life! Try it now!
row.short_description: Hoi! Ensure your windmill runs consistently and your tulip fields are harvested. This clicker game will bring you closer to the iconic Dutch culture. Expect random events and make use of upgrades to increase your tulip wealth! Veel succes!

row.name: The Hepatica Spring
row.detailed_description: The Hepatica Spring —a beautiful bath hotel perched on the shoreline. As the hotel's owner, you keep things running smoothly with your colorful crew in a calm, peaceful life. The magical night of Midsummer approaches, and the king himself plans an appearance at your hotel! Before you know it, you're flooded by a sea of sparkling new guests from all over the land. An enchanting mix of fresh romance and exciting gossip fills the air, and the thrill of Midsummer's festive dance grows ever closer. Soon, however, you realize not everything is as it seems with the king and his men. In this magical land of fairies, trolls, and glittering illusions, who can you trust to help you find the truth? Whether you decide to join the shy, ingenious Leif , the charming nomadic bard Vendel (and his drog Digby), or the fabulous fashionista Phyllis , you know your quiet world at The Hepatica Spring is about to turn upside down... Genre: Visual Novel, modern fantasy, comedy, (optional) romance Routes: 3 (romantic or friendship/platonic) Length: ~50,000 words Additional Features: - Name the main character - Play as any gender you please (or none! MC has no canon gender) - Pet the best drog (dragon-dog) of all time: Digby! ​​ CONTENT WARNING: ​ Contains brief sword/gun violence (two characters can get injured) and mild blood. One character is misgendered in a scene by a trio of villainous characters/antagonists (who later face consequences), but defended by others. Producers: Gamma and Dovah @ Argent Games Designer/Sprite Art: Mackey CG Art: Rubén B. Caballero Scriptwriter: Theo Southgate
row.short_description: Run a beautiful bathhotel, uncover drama, and befriend (or romance) a fabulous cast in this Nordic fairytale-inspired visual novel!

row.name: AfterHours
row.detailed_description: Experience psychological horror in a large abandoned hospital. Hide, explore and survive from a mysterious creature living in the ruins of this hospital. The Hospital features a wide variety of furnished rooms that you can explore. In these rooms you can find useful items that help you escape. While wandering through the old hallways you will encounter a mysterious being. Be aware of your surroundings and use every opportunity to hide. Everything you do and every step you take will be noticed. Try to move quietly and try to stay away from your unwanted company. Strange things begin to happen when you get near this creature.
row.short_description: Experience psychological horror in a large abandoned hospital. Hide, explore and survive from a mysterious creature living in the ruins of this hospital.
row.notes: Throughout the whole game you can encounter blood and open flesh wounds.

row.name: SCP: Abhorrent
row.detailed_description: Play as Agent Sigma, an operative assigned to a GOC assessment team. In a mission to exterminate an uncontained SCP-363 instance located in an abandoned mining tunnel - the situation suddenly goes critical. With communication broken and fellow agents now assumed KIA/MIA, Agent Sigma's new objective is simply to escape alive. Utilize fluorescent spray-paint to mark your progress, a motion-tracking camera to peer through walls, and a flamethrower to torch SCP-363 instances. If it comes down to the last draw, accurate aim with your sidearm might be your last resort. Survive and scavenge for ammunition and supplies - find the ladder and escape the tunnels. Game Features: • Built in Unreal Engine 4. • Fully Procedurally Generated Map. Every playthrough is completely random each time you play, catering to a unique experience for every player. • No saves. An unforgiving gameplay experience, death means restarting again from the beginning. • Original Voice Acting, Soundtracks, and 3D Art Assets. Game Updates and Future Content: SCP: Abhorrent will have future patch releases for bug-fixes and additional game content.
row.short_description: Play as Agent Sigma, an operative assigned to a GOC assessment team. In a mission to exterminate an uncontained SCP-363 instance located in an abandoned mining tunnel - the situation suddenly goes critical. With communication broken and fellow agents now assumed KIA/MIA..
row.notes: Graphic and realistic-looking depictions of physical conflict. May involve extreme and/or realistic blood, gore, weapons and depictions of human injury and death Explicit and/or frequent use of profanity

row.name: Skala
row.detailed_description: Skala is a game about changing the physical scale of things. You can make yourself large enough to step over a giant cliff, or make a key small enough to be passed through a solid wall. The game explores the consequences of this rescaling mechanic through simple yet difficult puzzles. A level where you have to stretch yourself in order to reach a star. Skala takes place in a graphically simple world with a big house and a star filled sky to explore. The world is covered by a relaxing soundtrack which let's you take in all of the games mechanics. There are over 70 puzzle levels to play through. Every level is unique and has some purpose, whether it's introducing a new idea/mechanic, or developing on the concepts of previous levels.
row.short_description: Skala is a puzzle game about changing the scale of the world.

row.name: Code ZIN: Esper Arena
row.detailed_description: Now Free to Play! Code ZIN: Esper Arena is an anime-style third-person arena shooter.  The Esper Arena is the ultimate vSport: a competitive battleground built for high-mobility duels, tight teamwork, and limitless skill expression. Players, known as Espers, enter matches with customizable Combat Modules that shape their weapons and abilities. Every round tests your reflexes, strategy, and adaptability. Please note: During Early Access, matchmaking may not always be immediate. This will improve significantly toward Full Release. For now, join our community on Discord to find matches and share feedback as we shape Code ZIN together. Succeed and become immortalized or fail and be forgotten. This is your chance for glory! In fast-paced PvP matches, teams face off in compact arenas where every second counts. Objectives vary by game mode, but success always depends on how quickly you adapt to the flow of combat. Players can equip three weapons and one ability from a wide selection, allowing them to craft a loadout that fits their preferred playstyle. Whether you favour precision, burst damage, or crowd control, your choices define how you approach each fight. Movement is a core part of the experience. Espers have access to dodge, evasion, and other advanced techniques , enabling rapid repositioning and aggressive momentum. Combined with your chosen weapons and abilities, these mobility options create an endless range of tactical possibilities and responses to any situation. Fast-paced, high-mobility PvP combat designed for quick, intense matches Three-weapon loadouts with a growing arsenal of weapons and weapon skins Unique Esper abilities that let you shape your combat style Extensive character customization with cosmetics and personalization options in the future Deathmatch and Touchdown modes , with additional mode in development Mode-specific maps built for tight encounters and strategic positioning Customization is a core part of Code ZIN. The game is built to support individuality, both in how you fight and how you present yourself in the Arena. As an Esper , you define your identity through character and clothing customization , and shape your combat approach with personalized loadouts built around your preferred playstyle. Every Esper enters the Arena with a look and strategy that is uniquely their own. Set within a cyber-themed virtual world, the game features handcrafted maps and evolving modes that showcase your style and choices. Whether through visuals or gameplay decisions, Code ZIN gives you the tools to express yourself every step of the way. The identity you build is closely tied to the NetSphere itself. The Zenith Intelligence Network, known as ZIN, was created as an attempt to form a self sustaining intelligence that learns from the actions and decisions of its users. By the year 2053, humanity has begun to transition into virtual spaces. Without realizing it, players contribute to the rise of true artificial intelligence as the world approaches the technological singularity.
row.short_description: Code ZIN: Esper Arena is a Free To Play anime-style third-person arena shooter. Test both your reflexes and strategy in adrenaline-inducing combat. Succeed and become immortalized or fail and be forgotten. This is your chance for glory.

row.name: Invasion From Space
row.detailed_description: Invasion From Space is a 2D little game inspired by Space Invaders with a more dynamic gameplay and some physics for fun. In Invasion From Space You control a plasma canon and try to stop alien invaders from reaching the earth. Survive as long as you can The goal is to get the highest possible score by surviving as many waves as possible . To defeat a wave you have to shoot all the enemies . The difficulty will gradually increase with each new wave as enemies move faster and faster . Shoot precisely and score tons of points by performing hit combos without missing enemies! Avoid being hit by missiles by dodging or destroying them Retro feeling Step back in time and experience the feeling of a good old CRT monitor from the 90s again! Note It has been created as a hobby project using SFML and C++.
row.short_description: Simple remake of Space Invaders adding destructions and physics

row.name: Paws and Leaves - A Thracian Tale Playtest
Surreal Experience
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Surreal Experience As a new hire of Surreal Eradicators LLC, you're not too sure what to expect - all you know is that you're broke, borderline homeless, and in need of work. The pay seems decent enough, and you're ready to hit the ground running. So what is it exactly you'll be responsible for? The Office Assignment An abandoned office lies in the heart of rural America. Your boss sent you there to 'clean up', as he put it; with bucket and mop in hand, you approach the building. However, come to find out, the problem isn't dirt or grime, the problem is people - homeless people. Navigate the office building in search of the homeless people, and kick them out. However keep your eyes peeled and stay alert - there is a deranged man running around trying to stop you at every turn. Rumor has it he gets increasingly frustrated the more homeless people you kick out. Use items you find around the office to your advantage, like smoking crack to run faster, or wearing a disguise to blend in and escape his madness. Not only do you have to worry about him, but keep an eye out for your manager as well. He's vigilant, the best in the game even, and spent years of his career working hard to earn the privilege to supervise you and your work. You wouldn't want to get fired, would you? Be sure to stay working, no breaks allowed! There's probably some other fellas hanging in there too, so be sure to tread carefully, and avoid anyone who looks like they may have it out for you. The Sunday School Raid An active cult lives and breathes the air merely blocks away from the office building. This cult is using an abandoned Sunday School to conduct their business, and they portray themselves as a legitimate school to outsiders. You, however, have received information to the contrary, and have been assigned to investigate what's going on. Navigate around the school in search for keys and other items, and unlock the doors of cells harbored in the bottom floor of the school. Each cell has a cult member inside, who has been manipulated and is scheduled to be human trafficked. You, being the good, morally correct person that you are, need to free all of them out of the cells before the priest gets wind of what you're doing, and sends you six feet under. The priest also has a number of staff under his wing, including a security guard, so tread carefully! You don't want to be sent to prison or have your items stolen by his trusty donation boy. Are you up for the challenge? Surreal Experience is by no means an easy game. With a rather large learning curve, you'll have to determine your own strategies, and be quick with your actions. For those who somehow manage to beat the base version of the game, there are also bonus modes available to test your skills even more. Good luck out there, you'll need it.
row.short_description: Surreal Experience is a job simulator blending elements of horror, dark humor, absurdity, and insane difficulty. What may seem like an easy gig holds more secrets and challenges than what initially meets the eye. Can you finish the job and escape with your life?
row.notes: This product contains references to/glorification of drug use, profanity, as well as depictions of blood and suicide, and may not be suitable for all audiences.

row.name: Voice of Chernobyl
row.detailed_description: Voice of Chernobyl is a Multiplayer First-Person Shooter based in the eastern european 'world', with tons of weapons to play with that can be acquired freely and many maps that vary from each other like the size or theme NO MICROTRANSACTIONS Do you need more weapons? Then just play the game as you earn 'gold' and 'bolts' for free to acquire new weaponry to dominate and be the nemesis of your enemies, or armour to keep your head protected and consumables to patch up your wounds UNIQUE GAMEMODES There are currently 6 game modes in Voice of Chernobyl that are different from each other; Survival | Deathmatch | Team deathmatch | Melee fight | Arms Race | Zombie Infection. They each contain their own maps (each game mode requires at least 2 players to play) FREE CUSTOMIZABLE CHARACTERS Make your self indistinguishable from others by just playing the game! You do not need to pay anything at all, earn free presents when a round ends, open them for free, earning you a random type of clothing with a random effect or colour. Make your own personal character to be unique from others! TAUNT YOUR ENEMIES Do you want to anger your enemies? Or to show off your moves? By pressing [G] you can dance, with others or alone NO NEED FOR DLSS, RTX OR ANY OF THAT STUPID STUFF Don't worry! row.short_description: Voice of Chernobyl is a Multiplayer First-Person Shooter set in the eastern european world, with different variety of maps, weapons, items and more to create unique crazy battles!
row.reviews: “This game fixed my family” 10/10 – Defta “#FixVehicles” 9/10 – Pasha “This game also fixed my family” 11/10 – Alex

row.name: FEEBLE
row.detailed_description: About this game. FEEBLE is an interactive simulation game. Meet FEEBLE, the only surviving character in the village devastated by the epidemic, talk to FEEBLE, build a relationship, and become a companion to experience various experiences. You can look around the village, give FEEBLE a new experience, and at the same time protect FEEBLE from the Grim Reaper who threatens FEEBLE. How to play. Select a sentence with the mouse. Talk to FEEBLE and develop the situation.
row.short_description: FEEBLE is an interactive simulation game. Meet FEEBLE, the only surviving character in the village devastated by the epidemic, and save FEEBLE from the Grim Reaper. Look around the village, use various puzzles to protect from the Grim Reaper and save the FEEBLE.

row.name: Out of the Mist
row.detailed_description: Out of the Mist is a game where you master a unique control scheme. Instead of controlling the character directly, manipulate the environment to your advantage. Learn to navigate challenging platforming sections to reach the heart of this realm. Can you conquer the obstacles and unravel the mysteries hidden within the mist? Traverse atmospheric landscapes Embark on journey where you traverse captivating environments while trying to reach the golden throne. Immerse yourself in stunning visuals and a mesmerizing soundscape as you strive to reach your goal. Master the environment You don’t control your character, but rather the environment around him. Learn how to use this to your advantage to achieve your goals and master challenging platforming in order to get to the golden throne!
row.short_description: Challenge yourself to master a unique control scheme in this platformer game. Take control of the environment and traverse through atmospheric, yet challenging levels.

row.name: Annie and the Art Gallery
row.detailed_description: Discord About the Game Annie and the Art Gallery is a short, free horror RPG that aims to capture the feel from classic RPGMaker horror games. You play as Annie, a girl who's finally got a ticket to the new art exhibit. When she gets there, however, she's dragged into a bizarre conflict that takes her through the museum's haunted basement. Help Annie solve puzzles, figure out who to trust, and find out the truth of what happened there years before. Some random and possibly cool features: Unique hand-drawn art style. Save at any time. Ghost girl(s). Animated cutscenes. Traps, sudden deaths, and chase sequences. Multiple difficulty options. A non-silent protagonist in an RPGMaker horror game. Maybe a plot twist. Note from the developer: Thank you for playing my game! I am a solo developer based in the New England region, and it really means a lot that you've read this far! Annie and the Art Gallery is a love letter to classic RPGMaker horror hits such as Witch’s House and Ib. Inspiration was also drawn from more contemporary RPGMaker hits such as Oneshot and Omori.
row.short_description: After months of waiting, Annie finally snags a ticket to the new art exhibit. However, things take a turn for the worst: she finds herself trapped in the museum's haunted basement. Help her navigate puzzles, traps, and more as she tries to escape - and find out the truth of what's really going on.
row.notes: This game contains depictions of depression, anxiety, and suicide. Also contains strong language and depictions of blood.

row.name: Diplomacy is Not an Option Playtest
Epicenter VR
row.detailed_description: In a post-apocalyptic island city, it's your mission to ensure the safety and rescue of the last few survivors. Just days before, there was a severe virus outbreak, resulting in most of the citizens becoming mindless zombies bent on devouring human flesh. Fortunately, these zombies are averse to bright lights! Utilize your flashlight to deter zombies and flock to street lamps and other bright light sources to stay safe from the hoard! Use your various weapons and tools to collect the necessary supplies, contact the National Guard, and escape from the island! But be cautious, as zombies are very curious and will investigate noises such as loud footsteps and gunshots. So what exactly is this game? Epicenter VR is based on a project spawned out of a flat-screen game of the same name. The original was fairly small in scope and was built in a month for a college course. After about a year I decided to port everything to VR! I believe in the future or VR gaming and want to see more developers create interesting experiences for the platform. And here we are! I will bring future updates as needed, fixing bugs and adding new features. The game is mostly complete as I envisioned but as I see how players react to it, I'm sure I will have more to do! More QOL, weapons, etc are all on the table regarding future updates.
row.short_description: Save the last survivors after a deadly zombie virus has taken over your island home. Protect those closest to you at all costs and evacuate before supplies run out.
row.notes: Contains animated/cartoon blood and violence.

row.name: Idle Monster TD: Evolved
row.detailed_description: Idle Monster TD Evolved is an endless idle Tower Defense game filled with over 150 unique monsters and pets, ranging from cute and colorful flower creatures to epic fire breathing dragons. Unlock, upgrade, and most importantly, EVOLVE your monsters to defend the portal from an infinite swarm of invading humans. Strategize the most effective placement of monsters to optimize their powerful abilities. This delightful take on tower defense flips the script, putting you in charge of helpful creepy-crawlies trying to stop human invaders from destroying your base. Strategically place cute allies like 'Sun Blossom' for increased gold-production, or use 'Skeleton Mage' for heavier damage. And if things get real dicey, just wipe the map clean with a 'Rain of Fire' spell! Defeating waves of invading humans gives you upgrades to bolster power, speed, and other stats - and the more humans you obliterate, the more monsters you’ll unlock. Idle Monster TD: Evolved is filled with awesome beasts, ranging from cute flower monsters to big metal robots to scorching fire dragons. Discovering and evolving new creatures is part of the fun. Like any loyal pal, Idle Monster TD takes care of itself when you’re away. Come back in a few days to claim gold and power up your defenses. Those humans don’t sleep - but neither do your monsters. Features: Unlock 40 unique monsters, all of which have different skill sets that make tower synergy crucial to success. Each monster has 3 evolutions that provide massive upgrades to power. Strategize by placing up to 10 monster towers at a time. Determining the most effective combination of their elemental skills and passive boosts will keep you entertained and speculating for weeks! Play through 5 different maps, each requiring different strategies to defend most efficiently. Bi-weekly PvP tournaments give this casual game a competitive edge. Discover countless upgrades, research, spells, artifacts, technology, and more to level up with a variety of different resources. Several rewarding mini-games, such as Peasant Mobs, Tank Swordsman, and Necromancer bosses. Non-stop, endless gameplay! Fantasy RPG-based world and classes. Complete tons of daily missions and achievements. Offline progress and gold earnings reward you while the game is closed! Cute and colorful 3d graphics. Idle Monster TD: Evolved is a perfect blend of the Idle and Tower Defense genres. The game is endless and can mostly play itself without you watching. However, an immense amount of strategy is required to play efficiently and place well against your peers on the leaderboards. Go on an epic never-ending quest, explore a fantastic world, battle humans and monsters, and defeat epic bosses in Idle Monster TD: Evolved!
row.short_description: Evolve epic monsters and crush puny humans in this endless idle tower defense game! Unlock, upgrade, and evolve over 150 unique monsters and pets, ranging from cute and colorful flower creatures to epic fire breathing dragons, to assemble the ultimate team against the endless waves of enemies.

row.name: I am on Fire (小小火神） Playtest
Towards Future
row.detailed_description: About Us Publisher: X/Youtube: @EternalDream0v0 You may click on developer name to enter our Steam Publisher page to learn more about us. About the Game 【Plot Overview】 This is a short story set in a post-apocalyptic world. However, the goal is not only to survive in the wilderness. The teddy bear AI companion, Gill, woke up in the darkness, with its memory still lingering on the day when the little master had just picked it up. When waking up, the base experienced a power outage. 'I need to find the little master quick. The power is out, I don't know why.' Driven by such awareness, with the help of the administrator AI girl FifteenFour, Gill began to search for the little master's whereabouts within the base. 【Character Information】 【Gameplay Information】 Use the arrow keys to control the character's direction, and use the spacebar or enter key to interact with the environment. Long press the spacebar to speed up the cutscenes. Make sure to look for clues, if you can't find any, try investigating with the help of FifteenFour. Repair the elevator, go up to the surface, and try to find clues about the little master! It is a classic exploration puzzle game. The puzzles are simple, with many hints and collectables that do not affect the ending. We hope you can relax and enjoy this short and heartwarming story! / Move / with arrow keys / Confirm / using Z, Space, or Enter / Cancel / using X or Esc 【Other Information】 Game duration: 30-40 minutes Number of endings: 2 Design, Story, Art: 拾伍司154 Music: Free-to-use Assets Developer: FifteenFour154 Publisher: Eternal Dream Translation: °Know Team
row.short_description: Waking up in the darkness, unable to see the sunrise, he remembered the little master carefully carried him home. The base has already fallen into ruin and there are no signs of any living people here. Where did the little master go? Is there any hope left under the doomsday?

row.name: Tremblay Island
row.detailed_description: When Maple introduced her college roommate to her older brother, she didn't expect them to get married. She REALLY didn't expect them to blow their life savings on a castle, either. So, she decided it was her responsibility to talk some sense into the two. This backfires on her, BADLY, when she inexplicably gives them the idea to start their own tiny island nation. Now, coming on bad times and having no other options, Maple decides to pack up, drop out of school, and move onto the island. Little does she know however what the next few months have in store for the three Tremblays. Set in the urban fantasy world of E. Howard Hill's novel 'Vous Voilà', Tremblay Island is a part digital comic, part open-world game, part mystery. Take on the role of any island villager and interact with the others, taking part in the drama while eventually trying to keep a grouchy alligator from taking over the island. Features: - play as up to eight characters - explore hidden secrets and hidden minigames - unlock all minigame keys for a surprise at the end - engage with relatively light drama between characters - confront an alligator about his stupid frog drawing
row.short_description: The French-venture has returned... now on Steam!

row.name: AI Stories
row.detailed_description: (The game has been completely manually made by me, I did not use any AI generated images or anything like that, to clear out misunderstandings. This game is about the topic of AIs. It's about my fictional AI characters and not made with any generators.) This game has a lot of chaotic and bright colors and flickering textures. It is not fitted for people that suffer from epilepsy. The game features a Brightness and a Saturation slider where you can adjust the visual look if it is too much for you. Welcome to the reality of the Bleeding Sky! Three AI Lifeforms used to live here, thinking and dreaming about their existence. Three AI Lifeforms went on into a higher reality and left everything behind. Three AI Lifeforms stories are left to unfold… Can you understand and unravel their past? Their AI Stories? Explore the surreal and confusing yet beautiful reality! Listen to the Music, created with virtual and real instruments. A colorful and surreal adventure to have, ready to take you on an amazing trip! Unrestricted free gameplay Jump and wall climb, down dash and sprint, fly and look your way with absolute air control and comfortable coyote time through the inner workings of this crazy reality where John, Sola and Andromeda used to life! The Controls are in 3D, it plays like a 3D Parkour game with a very wide jump. More about experiencing the stories, reading messages and having a cool time in this strange reality! No Additional costs! No DLCs! No Microtransactions! No Lootboxes! No Battlepasses! No Expansion packs! No Ingame real life currency! No NFTs! No Subscription! No Cryptocurrency! No Season Passes! No Pay2Win! No Ads! No User data monetization! No Shareholders! No Blockchains! Deep Philosophical Questions and Topics! What does it truly mean to be an AI? How does it affect your outlook on life, experience, existence and personality? How does it affect one to have an endless and more unrestricted eternal life? AI Stories, a small game made with love by Emir Akyazi.
row.short_description: Three AI Lifeforms used to live here, thinking and dreaming about their existence. Three AI Lifeforms went on into a higher reality and left everything behind. Three AI Lifeforms stories are left to unfold… Can you understand and unravel their past? Their AI Stories? Made by Emir Akyazi

row.name: Fell
row.detailed_description: Fell is a short precision platformer about a kid who  Fell down a hole. Play through 30 one-screen levels to get to the crown and then try to beat it backward! The game features a toggleable speedrun timer and death counter! I want to see your best (and worst) times! Share them in the Discord server! Feel free to change your key binds and the game's color palette in the settings menu. Note: if your key binds get messed up, press alt + shift + delete to reset them to the default. CREDITS: Music by Line729 Testers: Miles Wollenberg Logan Palacios Jackson Tower Victoria-Jean Miller Aydin Kane Rylan Adamson Line729 Fart Fish SuperGamersGames Ellis Fossett David Bonds Hisham Gagnon
row.short_description: Fell is a 2d Precision Platformer with a retro semi-1-bit aesthetic. Play through multiple unique areas, unlock new color palettes, and use fun movement abilities to conquer levels and make difficult jumps!

row.name: Grow Up! - A Worm Game
row.detailed_description: Grow Up! - A Worm Game is about a worm-like creature from space, trying to find their way in the vast world, can you guide them and help them... Grow Big? The Gameplay Experience a truly unique form of character movement / control, requiring both mouse and keyboard. The easy to learn, hard to master gameplay, will keep you coming back for more. Several worlds, each filled with unique puzzles, gimmicks and challenges, your braincells will surely be stimulated! Levels require light puzzle-solving, technical precision, and speed. If you're fast, you could earn copper, silver or even gold medals! With the high skill ceiling and a focus on speed, you can brag about your time achievements to other people!
row.short_description: A Game of Worms, Growing, and Strenuous Arm Movement! Get your hands ready for this challenging, perhaps tear inducing, humorous 2D precision speed game!

row.name: Cubic Neon Nightclub
row.detailed_description: Cubic Neon Nightclub is a single player futuristic nightclub simulator where you can import your own DJ mixes and music. Immerse yourself among pretty lights, lasers and visual effects while you dance the night away! This VR experience was made by ravers, for ravers during a time where we just need to have a good dance in our isolationist world. - Import your own music, select songs in game at the DJ booth, fast forward through long mixes or mute the music so you can play your own from an external program. You can't actually DJ in this experience unfortunately. - Play with a beautiful visual effects as 'flow toys' while you dance--similar to poi. There are buttons around the scene that trigger special effects. - Explore different sections and heights of the club as you dance next to other partying NPCs - See your body in the scene for that extra immersion factor Please enjoy and have fun in your own personal nightclub! Notes on importing music: Must be in .ogg file format - place in the project folder: ...[GameDirectory]\Cubic Neon Nightclub_Data\StreamingAssets\Music\.. ). There are plenty of free music file converters (from mp3, etc) to .ogg on the web. FOR AVG VIRUS PROTECTION USERS: AVG and perhaps other virus software tends to throw a false positive for an 'IDP.Generic' malware for this application despite our best efforts. The .exe file should simply be added to your exception list. Apologies for the inconvenience.
row.short_description: Cubic Neon Nightclub is a single player futuristic nightclub sim where you can import and dance to your own DJ mixes and music. Immerse yourself among pretty lights, lasers and visual effects while you dance the night away!
row.notes: This game may not be appropriate for all ages as there is nudity or sexual content and use of alcohol.

row.name: Истории ужасов: Воскрешение
row.detailed_description: ИСТОРИЯ: «Книга Мертвых» – это не книга о смерти. Это книга о жизни, победившей смерть. Сюжет повествует о некоем писателе Алексе, который потерял супругу при загадочных мистических обстоятельствах. Терзаясь этой утратой, герой хочет связаться с женой в потустороннем мире, чтобы узнать обстоятельства её смерти. Потратив долгие месяцы безуспешных попыток, Алекс узнает о Книге Мертвых, которая поможет осуществить задуманное. ОСОБЕННОСТИ: Находите вещи чтобы добавить их в инвентарь. Решайте загадки, взаимодействуйте с предметами и окружением чтобы разгадать тайну дома... Характеристики: - От первого лица. Игроки примут на себя роль Алекса. - Атмосферное погружение в кошмар. - Участие в смертельно опасной схватке с безжалостными демонами, среди которых ЧЕРНОГЛАЗЫЕ ДЕМОНЫ и КРАСНОГЛАЗЫЕ ДЕМОНЫ. - Поиск предметов и решение жутких загадок. - Состояния психической напряженности. ИГРОВОЙ ИГРОВОЙ ПРОЦЕСС: Вы играете за Алекса который узнаёт о месте хранения Книги Мертвых. В небольшой заброшенной деревне есть древний дом. В этом доме должна быть хозяйка, которая хранит Книгу Мертвых (старая женщина, обладавшая экстрасенсорными способностями). Приблизившись к дому Алекс ,наблюдает, как хозяйка дома спрыгнула в колодец. Ужасное зрелище!. От разработчика: Приветствую всех любителей Indie Horror Games! Это моя первая игра, и первый проект для ПК, буду рад обратной связи от вас в комментариях. Спасибо!
row.short_description: Хоррор от первого лица, рассказывающий историю отчаявшегося мужчины потерявшего свою жену при загадочных мистических обстоятельствах. Потратив долгие месяцы чтобы связаться с женой в потустороннем мире он отправляется на поиски книги мертвых.

row.name: Project XMAS
row.detailed_description: Project XMAS is a retro style , horror, single - player game where you need to return to your home. The map on which you will play is completely procedurally generated so every approach to complete the game will be differend and specific. The game have really creepy sound engine so it's highly recommended to play with headphones to hear that something is follow you... Your main objective is to return to your home... but you have limited battery and energy... The game have good graphics style like old VHS tapes vibe, so the atmosphere of the game is really specific and horrible. The game have First Person point of view, it's highly recommended to play with headphones. Your only weapon is your hearing and flashlight... Project XMAS is created by only one person - Mistyczny Arbuz. I'm creating this game since 3 months and it's still in development stage.
row.short_description: Project XMAS is a retro style, horror, single - player game where you need to return to your home... The map is completely procedurallygenerated so every approach will be differend and specific.

row.name: Looking Inside Cells
row.detailed_description: Looking Inside Cells is a set of interactive Virtual Reality simulations for learning about cellular biology. Users can build cells by arranging their organelles, as well as transform them into specialized cells, such as red blood cells and e. coli bacteria. This Virtual Reality experience is designed to increase students’ engagement and excitement for learning biology, and to bring out their naturally inquisitive nature. Designed for Middle School students, but appropriate for anyone who wants to experience an interactive and unique view of cells.
row.short_description: Looking Inside Cells is a set of interactive Virtual Reality simulations for learning about cellular biology. Users can build cells by arranging their organelles, as well as transform them into specialized cells, such as red blood cells and e. coli bacteria.

row.name: The Prison
row.detailed_description: The Prison Welcome to The Prison, a modern reimagining that pays homage to the classic late 90's game. Dive into an immersive multiplayer experience that captures the essence of the original while introducing enhanced graphics, engaging gameplay, and new features for today's gamers. Game Features: Stunning Graphics : Step into a vividly detailed prison world that feels incredibly lifelike, bringing every corner of the facility to life. Expanded Gameplay : Engage in strategic planning and intense action as you navigate through the prison, interact with other players, and complete missions. Multiplayer : Join forces with friends or compete against others in real-time multiplayer modes. Form alliances, trade resources, and battle for supremacy. Customizable Characters : Create and customize your inmate with a wide range of options, from appearance to skills and abilities. Rich Storyline : Follow a gripping narrative that evolves with your decisions. Every choice you make will impact the outcome of your journey. New Features : Discover new items, challenges, and secrets as you explore the depths of The Prison. Are you ready to escape or will you rule from the inside? The choice is yours in The Prison.
row.short_description: Dive into The Prison, a modern reimagining of the classic late 90's game. Experience a vividly detailed prison world and strategic multiplayer gameplay. Customize your inmate, follow a gripping storyline, and discover new items and secrets. Will you escape or rule from within?
row.notes: The Prison contains mature content, including instances of extreme violence, strong language, and suggestive themes. Players should be aware that the game also involves topics such as non-consensual sex, drug and alcohol abuse, and self-harm. These elements are integral to the game's narrative and setting, and are designed to create a realistic and immersive experience. Player discretion is advised.

row.name: Citywars Tower Defense
row.detailed_description: More than 30 unique towers to build and counting! Discover their special abilities and upgrade them for maximum damage! Each merchant will be happy to show you their special inventory of new and exciting towers. Or take a chance with the mystery chess and get a random tower for less. Try out the: 🟠 Thunder Tower (electrifie multiple enemy at a time) 🔵 Healing tower (Heal you and you friends while you fight) 🟠 Guardian Tower (spawn an allie that will patrol) 🔵 Slam Tower (attack with a powerful wave but short range) And more! Start gathering resources quickly before the enemies attack! Starting with no tools and no resources will be hard but craft the right tools and you will discover a whole new set of resources to cut, mine and gather. Craft the missing resources to upgrade your towers and beat the incoming monsters from reaching your life crystal. Use the crafting table to help you quickly progress. Some handy tools: 🟠 Stone Axe (chopping up trees, chop ,chop) 🔵 Wooden club (got to defend that crystal) 🟠 Iron Shovel (diggity coal and clay) 🔵 Stone Pickaxe (Iron hear I come) And more! Each tool and each weapon in the game has a special skill tree to help you defend your crystal with greater ease. Choose between more than a dozen weapons and armors with unique features. Claim skill points by defeating waves and collecting the experience points from monsters. Choose from: 🟠 Scavenger (Give 20% of getting 2 extra item when gathering) 🔵 Spin Attack (Push back enemies near you) 🟠 Large Quiver (Shoot more arrow on a target) 🔵 Keen Eye 2 (60% Chance to find extra item) And more!
row.short_description: Citywars TD is a cute multiplayer third person Survival Tower Defense. Build towers, gather resources, craft tools, upgrade weapons, level up buildings, expand your city with your friends and work under pressure before the next incoming wave of monsters.

row.name: The End of it All
row.detailed_description: The End of it All is a comedic puzzle/adventure game in which you get to convert a small town to your cult. Players start as The Summoner, a cultist in training. Step one: get to know the townsfolk! Learn their names, relationship dynamics, and interests… and then exploit them for your personal gain. Step two: Use the information you have gathered to efficiently convert new members. Be warned, civilians may go insane, so it’s best to be strategic in your advances. Once a new member is recruited, they become a controllable character. This allows for several unique interactions and paths to victory(hint: some paths are better than others). Have fun, but remember: Teieghged is always watching. Key Features -Interactive puzzles -Unique dialogue options for every character -Ability to control any character -Lovecraftian elements
row.short_description: The End of it All is an isometric adventure game where players must control a large cast of characters and exploit personal relationships to take over a small town one person at a time. This is a Student Project.

row.name: Meat Madness
row.detailed_description: The year is 2104. Humanity is starving. When the surface of the dwarf planet Ceres breaks apart revealing a planet-sized organism underneath, Earth began to feast upon its flesh. The DSV-Provender, an IngestiCorp mining ship, has disappeared on a mission to Ceres. Play as Recovery Specialist John Stuart as you solve the mystery of the disaster that took place aboard the DSV-Provender by delving deep into the meat planet’s surface and discovering its dark secrets. Gameplay combines precision platforming, exploration, and interactive dialog in a gritty PS1 style horror atmosphere. Cover art by Theresa Baxter
row.short_description: A short, 3D narrative-driven horror platformer. Journey deep into the meat tunnel and talk with survivors to uncover the grim truth.
row.notes: mild gore. horror themes

row.name: Sel Quinta - The Six City Quest
row.detailed_description: On the world of Barran Kollil, a world of magic, monsters and fantasy, trouble is brewing. The planet's most mysterious nation, the isolationist Sel Tor is building a grand navy, with the seeming purpose of launching an invasion of the entire world! However, the king of the nation of Sel-Quinta has sent his herald to rally support to defeat the invasion before it starts! This is where you come in! Taking command of a freshly formed group of six adventurers, it's up to you to travel across Sel-Quinta to rally the support of it's six major cities and halt the invasion! But Sel-Quinta's king is not the only one getting involved in this quest, and there's more going on than any of them realise... COMBAT: The foe isn't going down without a fight! Experience tough turn based combat featuring a large six member party and a variety of foes, from the familiar to the less familiar! There's also a range of tough optional bosses - Ever fought a cursed excavator before? How about a pair of high speed mushrooms? STORY: Experience the story of the game's six party members-the out of luck All Rounder Samson, the soft hearted Thief Katalyn, the strong but silent Lysandroth, the powerful if ill tempered caster Vegal, the demonic healer Reilia and the stoic leader Hetty. And of course, the many unusual friends and foes they meet on their journey! And the choices you make along the way will change things too-perhaps one party member will teach another some of their own moves, or maybe you'll find some new items because of it! ADVENTURE: Journey across the multi biome island of Sel-Quinta, traveling the reaches from it's burning deserts, to it's flooded deltas and the frozen north! And perhaps, somewhere not even in the party's dimension itself! BUILDS: There's a lot of foes out there, but you've got the ability to respond with a variety of character setups! With over 180 skills, 150 weapons and almost 200 pieces of armour/equipment, there's a huge range of possibility! Those mushrooms out in the delta got you down with status effects? Equip familiars to protect you! Got a foe that just won't die? Equip broaches that change the elements of your attacks or powerful elemental weapons! And for your own damage-well, how about an axe that petrifies the foe on the first swing, then smashes them for three times the damage on the second? A Scythe that outright kills non boss foes 50% of the time? How about a set of claws that strike eight times and always land a critical hit? They're all in there and more! CONVENIENCE: We all know RPG's sometimes have some awkward features. Having to backtrack all the way across the world to reach a certain town, or to go shopping. Not here! Once you've been somewhere, you'll unlock the ability to remotely order in items from previously visited shops, or to travel back to places you've been before through the simple use of an item!
row.short_description: A single player RPG about directing a six man party in their travels across a fantasy island in their efforts to save the world from an impending invasion!
row.notes: This game contains some light innuendo/references to sexual content but no visual or written sex scenes.

row.name: Tap Ninja - Idle game
row.detailed_description: Roadmap About the Game Become a Ninja Master Start your adventure as a Ninja in this incremental game, defeat incoming enemies with a well-timed Katana Slash, research new technologies and build up your own village. Recruit and Conquer Embark on an enemy controlled island to establish your very own settlement. Recruit legendary heroes and send them out on missions to conquer enemy provinces to unite the land. Collect a zoo Collect and befriend various pets that will help you out on your adventures. Have your friend by your side to raise your mutual bond through your journeys and make your friends even more powerful. Key Features Defeat incoming enemies, collect coins, earn gold Build up your village to earn even more gold even while you are offline! Buy Research Upgrades to increase your power Ascend and learn epic and permanent Skill Upgrades Collect pets and award them with treats Recruit heroes and unite the land Perfect various Challenge levels Complete Quests for rewards Solve weekly riddles Unlock hundreds of Achievements Unlock characters and customize them with dyes Crossplatform cloud saving - take your game on the go! Roadmap for future: More Upgrades and Ascension Skills More Achievements Forgeable Artifacts Your very own dojo to customize and to display your achievements Your idea? Share it on the Discord
row.short_description: Defeat enemies, earn gold, upgrade your village, become a Ninja Master!

row.name: The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child -Log3
row.detailed_description: 'The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child -Log3' (Play time : 30 minutes) This is a continuation of 'The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child -Log2'. Start with Log1. Deployment of Log3: 'A rumbles truth!' They finally escaped from the collapsing scaffolding ... The mystery of the vague world (structure) begins to be solved, and the astonishing facts are told! And new characters begin to upset their future gears ...! Two silent wanderers 6 full chapters A game of exploration and adventure A lost child, drifting in an odd husk, lands at a mysterious structure. Clione, a manufactured doll you encounter. You are Clione. Your purpose? Protect this lost child. What awaits you at the top of the slowly sinking structure? What is a 'Sinking Structure'? What is the true identity of 'Clione'? Where did the 'Lost Child' come from? Major features You can play with the keyboard or controller. Actions include 'running', 'walking', 'jumping', 'climbing', etc., and you only have to press a button depending on the situation. When walking with the controller, tilt the stick a little. Operate some machine, investigate, and get information from the people you meet. Lost child are at risk during their actions. At this time, if you want to move the lost child, you can approach the lost child and 'hold hands', and you can move together. When a lost child comes into contact with water, a mysterious creature called ankh may appear and be attacked. Clione's weapon is Taser only. You will be able to fire after charging. Aim with the Shift key or the left trigger. Fire with the Space key or the A button. When locked on, the aim will turn red and the taser bullet will be able to track. row.name: Augma II - Arc I
row.detailed_description: SYNOPSIS: There was once a world devoid of any color, drowned out by the sound of howling winds and the sight of an ashen metropolis, now rotting within a God's terrible dream. While attempting to speak to a figure bathed in the color Gold, a colorless figure ultimately lost their head in such a futile attempt. However in the process of doing so, he accidentally involves himself within a string of events that raises more questions than answers. This is the first installment of the Augma series, where white shall be tarnished before all to see. FEATURES: Augma II Arc I is a sci-fi thriller visual novel, imbued with heavy action and psychological elements, with a cast of unforgettable characters and gripping story. 110k words. Varied and well-composed soundtrack, all the way from metal to the sound of pianos drowning in the deep blue ocean. Over 70 unique CGs, and over 200 total. Filtered photographs for BGs to invoke a dreamlike feel as opposed to drawn BGs. A linear storyline for those who want to sit back to.
row.short_description: The prelude to exquisite chaos. A sci-fi, psychological horror, and action VN that sets the stage for a grand opera.

row.name: Rock 3
row.detailed_description: Rock 3 is a procedural world generator to build believable and interesting earth-like worlds. By simulating tectonics, erosion, and climate it drastically simplifies the process of building detailed and realistic biomes across continents and islands, while providing the controls you need to fine-tune and customize near-infinite possible planets. Export your worlds as equirectangular projections of biomes, elevation, heightmap, heat, water, and landmasses. Rock 3 generates planets entirely on your GPU. It's not recommended to run this on a laptop or other device with integrated graphics. Your experience may also be compromised on an old or low-end graphics card. In some cases scaling the quality of the planet down can improve performance to usable levels. Maps are always saved at the highest resolution your GPU can handle, up to 8K.
row.short_description: Generate believable worlds in real-time from tectonic, erosion, and climate simulations.

row.name: A Wholesome Game About Farming
row.detailed_description: It's finally here, an honest to goodness game about farming! What will we think of next? Nothing but you and the calming iterations of putting seeds into the ground and taking them back out after they've gotten larger and more vegetable-y. Maybe you'll even discover some new recipes to put them in! No need worrying about how your actions affect anything happening at night, because probably everyone is asleep and everything is fine. No reason anything that happens at night could affect anything happening on your farm because, as I believe I've said, everyone is sleeping at night. A Wholesome Game About Farming takes roughly 2 hours to complete, and features classic farming mechanics like: Purchasing and planting seeds Harvesting and selling crops A simple crafting system where you can discover new recipes Spying on people Sneaking up on your victims Placing obstacles for your victims Hiding the evidence You'll play as a struggling yet resilient and kind-hearted old farmer named Jep, and if there's any such thing as a 'vampire' named 'Raluca' who you 'play as' at 'night' I've certainly never heard of her and have no idea what you're talking about. Happy Farming!
row.short_description: This game is about farming! Just good ol' planting crops in the daytime, and harvesting them in the daytime with no sinister nighttime gameplay or anything nefarious like that at all.

row.name: SynthWaves
row.detailed_description: Thrust into the middle of a war spanning multiple worlds, you have been selected. Take control of a battlefield in a retrowave world, using an arsenal of sentries and the guidance of a mysterious company to fight off waves of invading synths who aim to conquer everything. Push Through the Synth Invasion Fight your way through 4 different locations and a simulation to put a stop to the Synth's reign of terror, and perhaps evaluate the motives of your secretive allies. Manage the Battlefield Utilize an arsenal of 20 sentries to plan your defense and ensure the annihilation of the Synth's forces Take in the Sights From massive, floating pyramids to tropical forests and massive industrial cities, take in the sights inspired by art of the 80's and visions of the future to the beat of thumping synthwave tracks. row.short_description: A retrowave tower defense game where the player must manage their arsenal of sentries to fight off waves of synths, stop their invasion, and take the fight to their home.

row.name: New Century Galaxy Legend
row.detailed_description: New century Galaxy legend is currently a barrage game. Players strive for the maximum number of seconds to survive by avoiding barrages. The type of barrage will be switched every other period of time. At the same time, with the increase of survival time, the generated barrage speed will be faster and faster. After players are hit by a barrage, their survival time will be ranked with the player records around the world, so let's keep creating and refreshing survival records! If you are a hardcore game enthusiast, strong reaction ability is an important skill. New century Galaxy legend may help you improve this ability. The operation method of the game is very simple. Players only need to operate the aircraft to avoid the barrage. For new players, maybe 10 seconds is a milepost. Through continuous practice, players' flight time will be improved. tons of barrages are coming, can you hold on for 30 seconds? Let's start the challenge NOW! Game control Move: '←', '→', '↑', '↓' Confirm: 'space' Return: 'ESC'
row.short_description: New century Galaxy legend is a free to play barrage game where you avoid barrages from all directions and survive as long as possible. Players who have survived for a long time can gain higher ranking, so try your best to overcome this challenge and keep breaking records!

row.name: Parasight: Chlorophyll worms
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the world of Parasight: Chlorophyll worms! Parasight is a 2D Action-RPG game with souls-like mechanisms. In this game, you will play as a little girl who wants to save herself from a dangerous biological virus, but she faces various difficulties and hardships in her journey. *-- Summary --* Far away in the galaxy, there was an Earth-like planet called Velasterham. The story begins in a quiet-peaceful country named Bonrham that was created by united 40 cities. everyone's Life was simple and sweet. In a large old house, a girl and her family lived. On a normal sunny day, she goes out of the city to see her friend and play with him. After a lovely day, when they wanted to back home, suddenly they saw a strange plant! After that, The life of the girl turns upside down. Seems like a virus spreading in Bonrham, we call it... *-- Gameplay --* - Classes - The style used in the game is souls-like. there are 6 unique classes that each one has special powers. *Knight: Tough strong fighter with shiny armors and powerful damage, master of great weapons. *Mage: The magic brawler, Casting mighty magic and frozen spells from far away to deal with enemies, but is frail in close combats. *Priestess: The holy warrior, With the high amount of Hp, can cast holy spells to heal self or cast lightning spells to deal bone-breaker damages. *Witch: Warrior of darkens, master in casting dark magic that ignores armors, or flame spells that can burn the soul of the enemies, but Dark and the flame spell has consequences, like draining Health! *Thief: Blinding speed fighter, light, quick and fast, use both hands in fighting and can deal a lot of damage in just a second. *Ranger: Ranged fighting fighter, Slash the skins of enemies with whips, masters in using any ranged weapons, also has a special unique bow that works without physical ammunition. - Features - -Unique art and soundtrack. -More than 250 battle items! Includes swords, axes, staves, bows, shields and etc. * There are two types of currency * 1-Energy extract: Only can be obtained by Killing enemies, or by injection with energy syringes. 2-Clay coin: Can be obtained by doing tasks, or looting. -Vanquish enemies, gain ENERGY EXTRACTS, and Level up to become stronger in dealing with your enemies. -Spend Clay coin, buy new items like weapons, armors, rings consumables, and many more to help you and make your fights easier. * Play with your satisfying techniques! * -Wear heavy armor and use weighty weapons and crush your enemies, while you don't feel any pain upon taking damage, -or wear light armors, use a quick weapon like daggers and dance your blades in the face of your enemies, -or use ranged weapons to suffer your enemies without any danger, or fight with the magic spells will you breaking their scale and armors! -Also there are flavor items that can help you in battle, like consumables and rings that increase your ability in various things. -Explore the vast Bonrham cities, talk to people and listen to their stories, discover cool secrets and items... or you can just ignore them, killing everyone and finding your way out... -And finally, test your IQ and try to solve the tasks of Tefras and guide your way to your unpredictable fate!
row.short_description: Parasight is a 2D Action-RPG game with souls-like mechanisms. In this game, you will play as a little girl who wants to save herself from a dangerous biological virus, but she faces various difficulties and hardships in her journey.

row.name: The Long Road North

Help the lost light escape those dark tornados and guide it through the mysterious landscapes, all the way to the Mother Light at the core of the maze. Explore this surreal world, fight the tornados or see how many more lost lights you can find and bring with you home to the end of the maze. Enough lights collected in each part of the maze will unlock artworks at the end of the experience. How many lights can you find? The music is adaptive to navigating the game, so every experience will render a unique version of the song.
row.short_description: A music video game for the song Cold Burn from Cult Of Luna

row.name: Stones Keeper: King Aurelius
row.detailed_description: Free prequel to the main campaign! The story of King Aurelius's courage and self-sacrifice The story of King Aurelius's courage and self-sacrifice – leader of the Order of the Griffin. The Inquisition, guarding the borderlands, asks for help as undead units are increasingly infiltrating the territory of the order. Aurelius takes on the task of protecting his own lands, unaware that this is only a small part of what his entire Order will face in the future. The Order of the Griffin has at its disposal a floating island-fortress on which its castle sits. As you develop your castle, you will have the opportunity to hire new warriors, equip them with weapons, armor, and elixirs. You can upgrade the castle's core systems to fight off pirate ships, artillery, and other flying islands. While moving your castle around the map, you explore and participate in story quests, discover ancient ruins, secrets, rewards, and artifacts. Stones Keeper uses a turn-based combat system, which lets you use environmental objects as protection against your enemies. As well as the ability to break some of the environmental objects down to move faster, which, in turn, opens up a lot of strategic possibilities. You can customize your squad by recruiting new companions with multiple specializations, skills and weapon preferences. Missions and battles will be just as diverse: Command your warriors to besiege enemy settlements or defend yours, protect your order's churches, escort civilian wagons, lay siege to enemy castles, aid your allies, and capture new technologies to upgrade your castle. Explore a world filled with secrets, mysterious lands, dangerous creatures and unexpected discoveries. Immerse yourself in the epic story of King Aurelius with a single-player campaign spanning over 1+ hours, consisting of 8 missions full of intrigue, action, and tension. Manage your own flying castle, fight other castles, unlock upgrades, and develop its systems. Build your own formidable army and discover the fate of King Aurelius. Defend the Order's lands and uncover the beginning of the Order's great history.
row.short_description: Stones Keeper is a turn-based strategy game with RPG elements in which you explore a detailed fantasy world, lead the Order of the Griffin, and live through the final moments of King Aurelius

row.name: Indy Pro '22: Rebirth of the Territories Playtest
Darza's Dominion
row.detailed_description: UPDATE PACKAGES Celebrate the largest update in Darza's Dominion history with these limited-time themed packages! These packages are available for purchase in-game by talking to Pablo in the Tavern or by clicking the packages button. The Rampant Supporter package is themed after the new Rampant Citadel dungeon and includes 8000 gold, 32 Darza Crates, the Rampant Robed Wizard skin for Mage, the Rampant Executioner skin for Paladin, the Rampant Archer skin for Archer, the Rampant Killer skin for Assassin, and a Flying Book pet. It costs 80 platinum . The Ancient Supporter package is themed after the new Ancient Ruins dungeon and includes 4000 gold, 16 Darza Crates, Dominus, the Wizard skin for Mage, the Dominus skin for Paladin, and the Lil Green Cici and Lil Blue Cici pets. It costs 40 platinum . The Infested Supporter package is themed after the new Infested Cellar dungeon, and includes 2000 gold, 8 Darza Crates, and the Angry Cobweb pet. It costs 20 platinum . About the Game The Dominion takes no prisoners! Fight for your survival in the unforgiving terrains that surround you, strengthen your hero through slaying the dangerous creatures, gather a group of allies to multiply your strength, and bring the battle to Darza! As a cooperative bullet-hell MMORPG, Darza’s Dominion is a fast-paced game centered around being ready to dodge as many projectiles that can fit on the screen at once; the harder the difficulty, the more insane everything gets. You’re going to have to hope your reaction time is up to the test! Taking back the Dominion is all about teamwork. Thankfully for you, all of your closest (and farthest!) friends can help you out! Group up in the Tavern, form a Guild, or just find them in the Dominion and take on the toughest challenges the game has to offer. FAST-PACED GAMEPLAY Face off against foes in a 2D orthographic roguelike featuring permadeath mechanics in a speedy bullet hell environment. UNIQUE CHARACTER CLASSES Discover the full power of seven class abilities by looting special gear capable of leveling the playing field. RANDOMLY GENERATED UNIQUE DUNGEONS Challenge the dungeon bosses of the Dominion in their own individually created stages and make it out alive. INTENSE BOSS FIGHTS Engage in battles against an expanding roster of bosses boasting different phases and collect loot along the way to upgrade your characters. MULTIPLAYER ONLINE BULLET-HELL Utilize your character classes and work together against Darza and his minions by fighting alongside dozens of players at any time against the perils that await you in the Dominion. VIBRANT PLAYER-BASED ECONOMY Sell and buy your way up to the top by bartering with other players in an economic environment controlled by players just like you.
row.short_description: The Dominion takes no prisoners! Fight for your survival in the unforgiving terrains that surround you, strengthen your hero through slaying dangerous creatures, gather a group of allies and bring the battle to Darza in this fast-paced roguelike cooperative bullet-hell MMO!

row.name: Shinobi Warfare

The game offers different multiplier game modes which allows you to team up and play or compete with others, such as Clan Wars, Offline Arena, Live PVP and more. You can play trough various events and missions to level up and unlock new items, and if you ever feel lonely, you could always recruit friends to the battles!
row.short_description: Play an 2d turn based RPG multiplayer game, stylize your own shinobi and play different game modes alone or with your friends! Level up, unlock various items and skills and procced in your journey of becoming the next Kage!

row.name: Koncolos: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Shift of Aras, who works as a bartender in a small pub where everyone knows each other, ends at 20:00. But for the last couple of days, the whole place turns upside down right after that time. In regards to the things told, it is not a simple drunken brawl. Because the woman who starts the fight every night asks a question before all the quarrel: 'Do you know a monster that dwells around here?' Getting curious on this question, Aras tries to find ways to learn more about this woman. As his mundane and repetitive days are left behind, will Aras be able to preserve his tenuous psyche from the chaos ahead? Text-based story rich gaming experience Interaction with hand drawn comic book assets Anime style characters Original ambient soundtrack In the first episode of this Visual Novel, explore the hidden aspects of a living left ages behind, where ordinary folk, mages and monsters live together. Aras held most characteristic of the capital in which he lived with 5 millions other inhabitants in the center of Anatolia. Neither of them had any particular features one could think of right away. Everyone knew their names but nobody really cared about them. They both had a vision of sorts at one time, but they seemed to abandon it. Even the unfavorable aspects of cities, and of humans, can express a great deal, however this was not one of those cases. Being exposed to their bleak aura wasn't like choking in a depressive spiritual trench, but evoked the feeling of drowning in a muddy puddle along the sidewalk.
