row.name: Kakuriyo
row.detailed_description: かくりよはアクション要素とオープンワールドを含むシミュレータです。 ゲーム内ではいろいろなロケーションを探索したり、アクションを試すことができます。 例えば森の中で寝そべって空を眺めてみたり、建物中を探索してみたりすることができます。 建物やロケーションは随時アップデートで追加していく予定です。
row.short_description: かくりよはシミュレーションタイトルです。 コンテンツの追加により色々な遊び方をお楽しみいただけます。
row.notes: 現在は成人向けコンテンツは含まれていませんが、今後の追加コンテンツによっては該当するものが含まれる可能性があります。

row.name: Planet after us
row.detailed_description: The Planet After Us computer game is an RPG set in a 3D world. The game world is not very large and is designed for five hours of playthrough, although in fact the game can take much longer on the first playthrough. The game has several professions that you need to learn and upgrade in order to collect resources and transform them into goods for sale. You will also have to learn the profession of a key maker in order to open the locks of chests. And of course, the most important thing is the pumping of various skills for fighting with opponents. The main enemy in the game are robotic tanks that roam singly or in groups around the map. The game has a rather complex combat mechanics, each gun has penetration and three types of damage. At the same time, the armor of opponents can also have different thicknesses and other parameters, due to which you may not be able to penetrate it, or vice versa, you will crit with every shot. Therefore, you will have to collect complex sets of weapons to kill every serious enemy. A feature of the game world is the presence of a super-dense atmosphere, due to which the projectiles fly slowly and during the battle the enemy can dodge your shot, so that even a volley from four different guns at the same time can be carried out past the target. It is necessary to predict the position of the enemy in space and strike ahead of time, correctly calculating the trajectory. The atmosphere of the game is generally relaxing, the opponents are not scary, even those areas where evil has settled, cemeteries with crucified skeletons look quite peaceful. Mostly a pleasant, pleasing to the eye beautiful landscape, strange trees, strange objects. What can I say this world was designed by robots. The plot of the game is as follows, a young man from our world got into the world of the future called Human Park and he has to put his own order in it. Human Park is a park built by robots to remember people, it has houses and all the attributes of architecture that was in the era of people, but at the same time cars roam the world. However, not everything is safe in this world, in recent years some mafia bosses have appeared who have settled in black fortresses, and the robots themselves living in the Human park have become aggressive, it's time to put things in order here...
row.short_description: The Planet after us is an RPG in an open 3D world, a feature of the game is the ability to put several guns on a fighter and at the same time the speed of the projectiles is comparable to the speed of the player’s movement, in order to hit the target, need to calculate the trajectory.

row.name: Corn Defenders
row.detailed_description: Corn Defenders A modern game inspired by many popular 1980s arcade games that depicts a student locked inside of a school You will need to trade for and collect corn to escape You will also need to run away from Dr. Small and the teachers current features - •Enemies •1980s arcade minigames •Highscore future features - •More minigames •Better Graphics •Larger map You can test out the beta on the website This game is in beta right now and (should) be updated weekly.
row.short_description: A modern game inspired by many popular 1980s arcade games that depicts a student locked inside of a school. You will need to trade for and collect corn to escape. You will also need to run away from Dr. Small and the teachers

row.name: VRUSEUM
row.detailed_description: Welcome to VRuseum , a virtual experience designed by Secondarybounce that invites the user to explore, through a 10,000m2 architectural space, a selection of world-renowned digital artists curated by Boldtron . Explore the museum with all the artworks or in 'architecture only', also individually visualize each sculpture in an isolated visualization mode. Visit all the zones, discover all the artist sculptures installations, unlock viewing modes and complete your collectible album. VRuseum contains galleries and open spaces that exhibits sculptures created by artists from the digital world. You can visit the museum downloading for free the application and choosing between 3 different modes: 1 - Virtual reality headset. 2 - Keyboard and Mouse. 3 - Touch screen. View modes: VR, First person, Aerial view, Photo, Camera. row.short_description: Welcome to VRuseum, a virtual experience designed by Secondarybounce that invites the user to explore, through a 10,000m2 architectural space, a selection of world-renowned digital artists curated by Boldtron.

row.name: Nonogram Kingdom
row.detailed_description: Come play Nonogram Kingdom, a world where you can explore a whole range of different places by solving nonogram puzzles and unlock amazing prizes that allow you to customize your game. These puzzles are fun and a great way to keep your brain active and to challenge yourself daily. Nonograms also known as Griddlers, Picross, Picture Cross, Pictograms or Kakuro are grid-based puzzles that can be solved by filling in cells based on clues provided on each row and column. These clues are given in the form of numbers that represent how many filled in cells there are in each block for each line. By using logic to work out which cells can be filled and using crosses to keep track of which ones cannot be filled you can eventually fill out the grid and successfully complete the puzzle. In Nonogram Kingdom, there are different ways you can play and enjoy completing these puzzles. There is the main campaign where you can progress along different levels, filling out jigsaw puzzles by completing nonogram puzzles and revealing hidden prizes like coins or customizable features. There is also the Journey Mode where you can complete puzzles to travel through different eras of time, starting from Ancient times and progressing into futuristic ages. ● 1000s of Nonogram Puzzles ● Puzzle Sizes ranging from 5x5 to 15x15 ● Customization of board, tile colors, backgrounds and more ● Multiple Modes to play on ● Easy difficulty up to Very Hard difficulty ● Daily rewards ● Hints and boosts to help solve puzzles If you enjoy Sudoku, Crosswords, Number Quiz, Minesweeper or Math games then you will certainly enjoy playing this game to.
row.short_description: Come play Nonogram Kingdom, a world where you can explore a whole range of different places by solving nonogram puzzles and unlock amazing prizes that allow you to customize your game. These puzzles are fun and a great way to keep your brain active and to challenge yourself daily.

row.name: Colony Cephea
row.detailed_description: A cartographer on a mission to chart routes to the first extra-galactic human colony discovers more than they intended to about the universe. This is a short, experimental top-down 2D action-adventure through space with cosmic horror inspirations. As the captain of a refurbished exploration vessel, you won't have many weapons at your disposal. You'll have to find your way through the maze of jump gates to Colony Cephea using only your light and your engine. Collect of the map information to plan a route for future vessels to the nascent colony. While keyboard and mouse are supported, the intended experience is with a controller. This game is free-to-play with no in-game purchases and is roughly 1 hour long.
row.short_description: Nav charts are required for Colony Cephea, the first human colony outside of the Milky Way. Be our guiding light as humanity steps to the precipice of greatness. A short experimental, horror adventure.

row.name: Ring War
row.detailed_description: ENTER      —      GATHER      —     CONQUER Become your own bullet hell in Ring War! The online PvP top-down shooter where you can instantly join a lobby with up to 15 other players, scavenge a loadout from a pool of over 250 unique items, and battle to the top of the leaderboard.                            Join or host a lobby to play with up to 15 other players online 250+ unique items make every encounter unique and each match endlessly competitive Battle to the top of the leaderboard alone in a Free-For-All match, or alongside allies in the 2 Teams or 4 Teams modes Complete a variety of achievements as you master different items Kill enemies, scrap items, and take control of the central ring to gain experience and level up Getting in or out of a lobby is quick, so you can enjoy playing casually or more seriously regardless of whether you have time for a few hours or just a few minutes Customize yourself with beautiful combinations of animated patterns and color palettes                            Download and play Ring War for free ! While Ring War is mostly a complete experience already, there's always room for suggestions or feedback directly from the players for future content and updates! row.short_description: Become your own bullet hell in Ring War! The online PvP top-down shooter where you can instantly join a lobby with up to 15 other players, scavenge a loadout from a pool of over 250 unique items, and battle to the top of the leaderboard.

row.name: Hexa Td - Free Game
row.detailed_description: A roguelike tower defense game with backpack management and route planning, while also incorporating a number of innovative gameplay elements Game Features: Design enemy pathways by combining buildings and walls (enemies will move between buildings); Buildings have various tags, and they can be upgraded and starred; Enhance their abilities by arranging buildings (rotating & moving) to maximize their potential (the more stars, the better); Buildings can be placed on walls to make the most of space; Semi-turn-based, players can only operate (shop & plan) when upgrading, otherwise, it's a idle game! Further Notes: Due to production costs, the game doesn't have a lot of content, so it's completely free; The development time was short, and there were only two developers, please be understanding and engage in discussions; For any issues, you can leave a comment on Youtube or send me a private message.
row.short_description: A roguelike tower defense game with backpack management and route planning

row.name: Ethereal Rift
row.detailed_description: Ethereal Rift is a procedurally generated ARPG based around crafting builds, gathering items and hack and slash combat. Each level is designed to be played in one sitting, with each attempt granting you access to different and more powerful build options for future attempts. The action takes place in the middle worlds, the corporeal planes between the ether and the void who are in an eternal dance of conflict and power. Each middle world has multiple bosses and unique challenges to overcome, requiring you to adapt and specialise your builds to be successful. Take on the middle worlds with pseudo Roguelike gameplay. Each time you take a new host, you will be weak and without a means to defend yourself, you must gather resources and find equipment, helping those aligned with you and killing those who are not. As you progress helper spirits will offer you their blessing to help you take on the void spirits who are infiltrating that world, leading to epic boss battles that will take skill, timing and preparation to overcome. However, should you die and cant find a suitable host in time you will lose all progress in that world and be forced to return to the ether. Craft powerful and unique builds. As you progress through the worlds your host will level up and get stronger, although how they get stronger is up to you. As your host levels up you will be offered a small selection of blessings from the whisps that you have unlocked, getting more powerful with each level. You can also obtain lower level blessings from whisps that you find hiding in objects in the middle worlds, and if you dont already have have them you will unlock new blessings for future attempts. There are many different types of whisps available, granting blessings such as the ability to strike two times for every hit, reflect a small amount of damage to all nearby enemies, or even to stack poison damage on each hit. Play with friends! Ethereal Rift is playable by yourself, or with up to 3 other friends, and they can drop in and out in the same save game whenever you return to the ether. Stuck on a tough boss? get some friends around and take them down as a team! Explore new worlds. Take your time and explore the procedurally generated worlds, each one extremely unique and beautiful, and teeming with hidden secrets for those willing to look.
row.short_description: Ethereal Rift is a procedurally generated ARPG based around crafting builds, gathering items and hack and slash combat. Play with up to 4 players in this dark fantasy adventure, slaying huge creatures and dark spirits to bring peace to the middle worlds.

row.name: Qwilight
row.detailed_description: Qwilight은 현존하는 리듬 게임 중 가장 많은 기능을 가진 무료 BMS, BMSON 구동기입니다. 다양한 게임 모드 지원 15개의 게임 모드를 지원하며 각각은 동시에 적용할 수 있습니다. 오토 스크래치 미러, 랜덤, 슈퍼 랜덤, 하프 랜덤, 마디 랜덤, etc. 음악 속도 조절 Fade out, Blink 판정 난이도 커스터마이징 라이프 게이지 커스터마이징 Chaos (4D, etc.) LN, CN 모드 라인 축소, 확장 (7＋1K => 6K, etc.) LN 제거 혹은 FULL LN 모드 변속 제거 역재생 추가 노트 배치 간접 미스 추가 DBM (7＋1K => 14＋2K, etc.) 다양한 하드웨어 지원 키보드, 터치 스크린, 비트콘, 게임 컨트롤러, MIDI를 지원합니다. RAZER® Chroma™, ASUS® Aura™, CORSAIR® iCUE™ LED 제어를 지원합니다. ASIO 2.0과 NVIDIA® Reflex™을 지원하여 최적의 레이턴시로 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다. 8000 Hz 키보드 (CORSAIR K70 RGB, etc.)도 제대로 지원합니다. 최대 4K 해상도와 60 Hz 이상 주사율도 별도의 설정 없이 바로 지원합니다. 온라인 랭킹 BMS 플레이 후 서버에 플레이 기록이 등록됩니다. 다른 사람들의 기록들과 실시간으로 경쟁할 수 있습니다. 온라인 리플레이를 지원해서 다른 사람의 플레이를 볼 수 있습니다. 온라인 대화, 멀티 플레이, 관전, 음성 대화 대화방과 멀티방을 생성하고 다른 사람과 대화하거나 멀티 플레이를 즐길 수 있습니다. 멀티 플레이는 방장이 노트 파일을 공유할 수 있으므로 모든 사람들이 미리 준비할 필요가 없습니다. 다른 사람의 플레이를 관전할 수 있습니다. 같이 멀티 플레이를 하면서 음성 대화를 할 수 있습니다. BMS, BMSON 에디터 연동 BMSE, iBMSC, uBMSC, BmsONE 에디터와 연동을 지원합니다. BMS 다운로더 제공 합법적인 방법으로 BMS, BMSON 노트 파일을 다운로드 받을 수 있는 다운로더가 내장되어 있습니다. 더 이상 BMS는 입문하기 어렵지 않습니다. 코스 플레이, 도전 과제, 단위 인정 여러 곡을 연속으로 플레이하는 코스 플레이를 지원합니다. 사용자가 직접 코스를 만들 수 있으며 커뮤니티에서 미리 만들어진 검증된 코스를 통한 도전 과제, 단위 인정도 제공하고 있습니다. 난이도 테이블 써드파티 프로그램을 사용하지 않고 구동기 자체적으로 난이도 테이블 주소를 입력하면 자동으로 연동됩니다. 연습 모드 타 구동기 대비 개선된 오토 플레이 기능을 제공하고 패턴 감상 뿐만 아니라 오토를 잠시 풀어서 원하는 위치에서 연습할 수도 있습니다.
row.short_description: Qwilight은 현존하는 리듬 게임 중 가장 많은 기능을 가진 무료 BMS, BMSON 구동기입니다. 다양한 게임 모드, 다양한 하드웨어, 풍부한 온라인 기능, BMS는 입문하기 어렵다는 고정 관념을 깨는 뛰어난 접근성 등을 자랑합니다. 또한, 게임 내 도전 과제와 프로필의 호칭은 공식 디스코드에서 제안하면 추가되는 커뮤니티 기반 콘텐츠도 제공됩니다.

row.name: Ghosts of Hollow Creek
row.detailed_description: Features As an Ice Mage learn to summon a Frost Minion who acts on its own to heal and do damage. As the Gambler collect and play cards against your enemies. As a Vampire use Vampiric Touch and other skills to destroy your enemies. Choose your party members' and love interest's look. About the Game Ghosts of Hollow Creek is a story-rich, single-player, 90s-style fantasy RPG with multiple endings to the game's story (roughly 15 to 20 hours to complete). All the characters in the party are customizable by look, name, and class. The romantic interest of the main character is also customizable so the player can enjoy a relationship that appeals to them. Combat is turn-based and each of the available 12 classes is designed to play differently. While the game is focused on the main quest line, there are side quests available and player can explore on the World Map. Weapons can be upgraded, armor crafted, and fishing/cooking is available when Camping. The player can also run dungeons (Lacuna Dungeons) on the side during the story to level up, find gear, gain gold, etc. if they find they are behind in level or gear for a quest area. A Tutorial is also available in-game from the title screen.
row.short_description: A fantasy story-rich turn-based RPG with customizable characters and romantic interest.

row.name: Spirit of Shotgun
row.detailed_description: message to the players Dear valued players , Due to a planned re-release of Spirit of Shotgun , we will temporarily suspend the game's availability in the store for the time being. Players who already own Spirit of Shotgun will get to keep it, and also get a copy of it's re-release for free - should it be released separately. We truly appreciate all enthusiasm towards Spirit of Shotgun, and therefore we want to make it better and more enjoyable for new and returning players. Why not just an update? Due to internal changes in how we will handle our Steam page and related accounts in the future, it is better for us to re-release the game. The gameplay will have new core mechanics which might strongly overhaul how the game plays, making the re-release a more exciting option for us. As we move on to our next projects, we want to firstly ensure Spirit of Shotgun will stand strong as a polished and supported title to return to. Please stay tuned for further updates and announcements regarding the re-release of Spirit of Shotgun. We will keep you informed about the progress and any new developments as they unfold. Warm regards and kind thanks, Team Vever About the Game „ Spirit of Shotgun: Platforming Escapade, Never in Silence “ is a 2D platformer adventure with a twist! With no other way to move around, your quest is to blast yourself upwards with the kickback of a shotgun, and find your way to the surface of the world! Story „The prophecy spoke of a light in the darkness... The Sun’s final spark would descend into the deepest abyss, and await the coming of the Saviour…“ You find yourself in a strange predicament – being stuck up to your waist inside a talking wooden barrel, who has – along with you – lost it’s memories to the darkness of the Abyss. You can’t recall why you ventured into the deepest place on Earth, yet know that the lantern you carry is of great importance to your quest. Can you rediscover the past and uncover the fate of the world – and the point of your journey – as you climb upwards? Guided by nothing but the Holy Spirit of an almost extinct religion called „The Way of the Shotgun“ , you need to light holy shrines, replenish ammo, uncover Ancient Shotguns and use them to reach places no ordinary shotgun-less human could. Gameplay Your shotgun can fire twice before reloading! Shoot once, then again in mid-air to alter the direction of your flight, or blast both barrels at once for a much stronger jump! Mastery is key! Learning from your mistakes is a must - every stage of the climb presents an increased level of challenge, with no checkpoints to guard your progress... Should you make a grave mistake – climb once more from the depth you fell to! - Multiplayer! Join your friends on the journey to the surface! Other players shall appear in your game as “phantoms” - ghosts from different worlds and timelines. Watch them closely as they advance alongside you, and learn from their mistakes! - Light Shrines as you climb upwards! The ancient Sprit of Shotgun was forgotten and only you can bring back it’s former glory! Shine your lantern on abandoned shrines to restore them, and have them provide you with ammunition! - The ammo you carry is limited! Should you make too many mistakes and end up with no shells left, you‘ll be forced to return to the last Shrine you lit! Keep an eye on your ammo count at all times, as shrines are not always guaranteed to be near... - No checkpoints! But... You can find an item called „Martyr’s Bone“ scattered around in the Underdark. These sacred objects can be used to transport you upwards to the last shrine you lit, in order to recover your progress! However, once spent – they’re gone for good. Save them for a rainy day. - Bullettime! Your talking barrel companion has the magical ability to slow down time, which works in tandem with your double-barrel shotgun. Fire once on the ground to blast off, enter Bullettime, then shoot once again in mid-air to alter the direction of your flight! If executed with precision, this technique will allow you to traverse any region of the Underdark in seconds. - Achievements! There’s a bunch of achievements. Nice! Environment - Many realms of the Underdark await your arrival... Be it places from ancient mythology, such as The Pits of Tartarus, or the resting place of the Ice-Father Ymir, or realms long forgotten – like the great Nether Frontier and the Desolation... All of them bring something new to the table, both lore and gameplay-wise. - Atmosphere! Every stage was meticulously conceptualized, drawn and assembled to form a cohesive whole that gives off it’s own unique sense of atmosphere – each with it’s very own soundtrack, high-definition ambiences, lore and secrets! - Collectibles! In places that are often challenging to reach, you can uncover a blast from the past... – the Ancient Shotguns. Each was designed to stand out with it’s unique environment-themed appearance, as well as it’s own sound, lore and special effects. Uncover them all to become the owner of the Great Collection! The Way of the Shotgun is our only salvation! Will your faith be strong enough to reach the end?
row.short_description: „Spirit of Shotgun: Platforming Escapade, Never in Silence“ is a 2D platformer adventure with a twist! With no other way to move around, your quest is to blast yourself upwards with the kickback of a shotgun, and find your way to the surface of the world!

row.name: Desolate Shores
row.detailed_description: Desolate Shores is a classic single player shoot-em-up game based in a Mars of the future. Control your soldier to defeat the growing alien hoard and escape with the aid of the Colonel! Landing on a desolate futuristic Mars, you'll be left to fend for yourself against the incoming waves of attack from deviant creatures trying to protect their eggs. After making your way down from the building where you parked your shuttle, your immediate goals will be to collect tokens to help operate the lift system and get to the control centre where you will receive further instructions from your superior officer. Back Story Terraforming has transformed the planet, creating a breathable atmosphere using plants and bacteria. Cities were built. At first things prospered, but the scientists did not anticipate how much ice was buried below the surface. Soon parts of the planet were flooded and the settlers converged on the parts that were on high ground. Not all those converging on the high ground were humans. Alien life lived below ground, an ant-like colony of humanoid creatures guarding their eggs. They too found refuge on high ground, bringing their eggs with them. You have responded to a distress signal from a cut-off island and have landed to try and find survivors. Follow instructions from your superior officer and then try and escape back to base.
row.short_description: Desolate Shores is a single player shooter game based in a Mars of the future. You have landed on one of the new islands that dot the land. Find your superior office and follow instructions to collect what you need and escape

row.name: click to ten
row.detailed_description: click to ten is an interactive clicking game where you click it and you get it to go up there.
row.short_description: click to ten

row.name: DuolBots
row.detailed_description: Grab a friend and build your very own battle bot. Decide on which parts your bot needs. Should you put on a paint blaster? Hack on a mechanical hand? Perhaps place a penguin on top? After you've decided, take your creation into battle against another team in online combat. Communicate with your partner to control your bot. You both control every part but each part has had their controls split among you. You may be able to aim a turret but only your partner can fire it. Level up your teamwork in this combat experience unlike any other.
row.short_description: Grab a friend and build your very own battle bot. Add weapons to you bot and take your creation into battle against another team in online combat. Communicate with your partner to control your bot. You both control every part but each part has had their controls split between the both of you.

row.name: Perfect Ball
row.detailed_description: You go on a long journey as a ball. All you have to do is get to the top. You can't move alone. Because you're a ball without arms or legs. However, even if you can't move on your own, it's possible to move the ground you're standing on. Rotate and tilt the ground so that you can climb up! Of course, it will not be an easy journey. You can't stop or jump up wherever you want. Also, all kinds of obstacles will interfere with you. However, don't give up and go up. It doesn't matter how many times you fail. Even if it takes a lot of time, put all your strength into it, tilt the ground, and reach the top along with the tilted land. The top of the lonely world will wait for you forever.
row.short_description: This game is a 2D platformer game that becomes a ball and travels. You can't move on your own, but you'll reach the top if you tilt the ground and climb it. Don't ever give up. The top of the lonely world is always waiting for you.

row.name: Fray Fight
row.detailed_description: All roads end in Valhalla, but the legacy you build before reaching your doom is up to you. Pick your character and choose your build carefully while you survive waves of enemies and attempt to make it where no one has before. Battle swarms of thousands of enemies while strategically planning your build. Gather enough gold and choose your items carefully to unlock powerful synergies and make it through the next timed wave. Game Features 6 unique characters with more being added 40+ Items 3 epic bosses 4 maps 27 achievements Meta upgrades Supports keyboard, controller, mouse, and touch screen
row.short_description: Battle the evil hordes on your way to Valhalla. Annihilate thousands of monsters with overpowered attacks and upgrades.

row.name: Knightfall: A Daring Journey
row.detailed_description: Knightfall: A Daring Journey is a horse-drifting Battle Royale game! Up to 28 players pair up in teams of two with the goal to reach the castle and pluck the rose before anyone else. The journey will take many days and the knights must take shelter in different towns on the way so as to not freeze to death during the harsh nights. As the journey continues there are fewer and fewer towns, and each team can expect to have to fight other pairs of players to take shelter. By being the first team to reach each town, they ensure the first pick of the weapons and healing bandages that they’ll need to defend themselves against the approaching pair of knights. Each morning it’s time to quickly get back on the horse and race towards the next destination until finally, they have their chance to pluck the rose! Features Battle Royale! 2 Player co-op (invite your friend or get matched with another player) Up to 28 players in each round Private and open games Knight on knight action Horse drifting Guns and grenades! 2 knights 1 rose
row.short_description: Two knights, a strong bond, and a long journey. Take up the race for the rose, ride from town to town and take shelter before nightfall by any means necessary! If your bond is strong and your horse drifts well, you can be the recipient of the fabled rose. Luckily you brought guns!

row.name: Set Sail
row.detailed_description: Set Sail is a western visual novel set in the modern day where the Golden Age of Pirating never properly ended. The player takes the role of a young pirate who has lived their entire life sheltered on a famous pirate ship known as The Red Plague, captained by The Demonic Pirate Ricardo. Through a first person perspective, you meet and engage with colorful characters on your pirate ship, the odd members of the Pirate Culture Club, and people you regret interacting with in the first place. You make the decisions on where to go and who to interact with, these choices impact dialogue, relationships, and future events of the game. What you download is a stand alone experience, but with more downloads and support a full game could get made.
row.short_description: Set Sail is a western visual novel set in the modern day where the Golden Age of Pirating never properly ended. You get to meet characters interested in the world of piracy and choose how your days on the main land go.

row.name: Dissonance
row.detailed_description: Dissonance is a 3D topdown adventure thriller game. The story sets in an abandoned research facility. As an organization agent that contains and extracts unknown artifacts and creatures, you have been sent on a special mission to find the missing team. Discover the secret within the abandoned facility and find out what happened here. Use different gadgets to help you in your mission. Flashlight Scanner Interact with the environment Gameplay Explore, find items to help you, and note to find out what happened. Enemy encounter, defeat your enemy through various ways. Bosses, challenge yourselves with different bosses using gadgets throughout the level. About Resonance Studio Resonance Studio is a University of Utah EAE graduate student Studio. Dissonance is a two semesters project that we developed in about 7 months. Many thanks to Berklee College of Music students for their incredible contributions to this project.
row.short_description: Dissonance is a top-down 3rd person adventure game. Players will encounter supernatural anomalies and creatures. Find and use specialized gadgets to aid you in your journey. Explore the abandoned research facility and reveal the secret of the organization that sent you here.
row.notes: There is some blood in the background.

row.name: Thunder League Online
row.detailed_description: Thunder League is a strategic fast-paced MOBA-styled game supporting up to 5 vs 5 in each match, where you play as a team to complete objectives against the opposing team. With absolutely no pay to win schemes; take full control of your gameplay and master several strategies in this skill-based game that rewards team work ! Thunder League Online offers both competitive & casual game modes with many more to arrive. Play as various unique agents and use their unique abilities to change the outcomes of this chaotic team-based battle arena ! Immerse in an EPIC 5 vs 5 team-work gameplay... or even dominate all by yourself using your characters abilities & destroy destructible objects to obtain even more powers to crush your enemies with cool strategies ! Own your enemies with style by customizing your character with various skins & accessories ! Dominate the competition & compete with other agents in the public rankings board! Get competitive and enjoy the third-person perspective of controlling a character in a MOBA-styled game. Thunder League was carefully designed for both Casual & Competitive players! Play with your friends and have an experience like never before!
row.short_description: A strategic fast-paced MOBA-styled game where you play as a team to complete objectives against the opposing team. Play as unique agents with a third-person view and use their abilities to change the outcomes of the chaotic battle arena with various game modes! No pay to win, just pure skill!

row.name: The Creature of Chaos
row.detailed_description: Ever wanted visit one of Dracul's castles? Wondered how do they keep changing? Maybe experience non-euclidean horrors and confusion first hand? You're in luck! For the first time in history, we're opening Zlowrogowo Castle to the public! Fast Paced Fps Action Run and gun everything that moves. Take monsters from safe distance with your trusty revolver, go close and personal with double barrel shotgun or even use enemies against each other. Go explore off the main path and you may find artifacts that make you stronger, just be careful not to get lost... Both purely procedural and handmade locations The castle and it's surrounding grounds always change and most of areas you'll see only once. Few rooms resists chaos, but this doesn't mean they're safe... Variety of game modes Campaign mode - tackle main path that leads deeper into the castle and face fearsome guardians at the end of each zone. Arcade mode in which you will be given limited time to go as far - and score as much - as possible. Custom map mode - play around with map generator and create your own levels.
row.short_description: Frantic FPS game with very procedural levels
row.notes: Mature content warning: blood, drug references

row.name: Tales of Novariel
row.detailed_description: IMPORTANT: The game is currently playable but in a really basic state. It is currently not under active development anymore! The land of Novariel is a vast and peaceful one. But one day slimes in different colors and clothing appeared and made the once peaceful world a dangerous one. Create your hero and fight against the slimes! Free the cities, help the lost citizens and explore a vast world ready for you. This game is a singleplayer RPG. It features a basic character creation, round based combat and an endless world. World generation The world is procedurally generated and offers currently the following tile-types with the mentioned content: City: Houses, Trees, Rocks, Ores and NPCs Forest: Trees, Rocks, Ores, NPCs, Enemies Plane: Trees, Rocks, Ores, NPCs, Enemies Mountain: Trees, Rocks, Ores, NPCs, Enemies River: Trees, Rocks, Ores, NPCs, Enemies, River Lake: Trees, Rocks, Ores, NPCs, Enemies, Lake Desert: Trees, Rocks, Ores, NPCs, Enemies, Lake Races Choose between the following races: Human: The basic race. Dwarf: Small but strong, always ready to fight. Elf: Fragile but agile. Never angry an elf with a bow. Giant: The biggest race in Novariel. Stupid but dangerous. Goblin: The rarest race. You want to challenge yourself? Play a Goblin. Nightelf: Elfs but with dark mode Classes Choose between the following classes: Warrior: You want a sword? Take it. Mage: -Weird magic noises- Thief: Why are my pockets always filled with gold?
row.short_description: Explore Novariel, a procedural generated land filled with various slimes. Fight your way through and gain rewards fitting your achievements. IMPORTANT: The game is currently playable but in a really basic state. It is currently not under active development anymore!

row.name: Aces Under the Moonlight™
row.detailed_description: Aces Under the Moonlight is a lightning fast PvP game where you try to get the ball into the opponent's goal. Speed is the name of the game here: the more goals that are made, the faster the ball goes the more times you hit the ball, the faster the ball goes the more time the ball bounces of the stage, the faster the ball goes the higher the combo, the faster the ball goes Take control of characters inspired by underground punk, each with unique movesets and abilities. Play ball in 4 different modes including Crosscourt Brawl, a 1v1 mode where you forget the ball and just smack each other around. Hop into training mode to hone your skills or go to Crosscourt ball mode to remove the net and have full freedom in your movement. Master attacks, parries, and air-dash to dominate your enemy.
row.short_description: Action Sports is about to get a shot of pure fire. Run, jump, and Airdash your way to victory in this hand animated, high speed, punk-inspired ball game set against backgrounds of urban decay. Get ready for an absolutely electric experience.
row.notes: The characters have skimpy clothes including thongs and pasties, background art has some implied nudity, and some implied arousal.

row.name: PI.EXE
row.detailed_description: PI.EXE is a challenging action/platformer that takes place in the inside of an operative system's server! Slash through your enemies as your make your way through each sector of the server, in order to rid the whole system of the virus that has grasped it! A single means of offense: A sword that can slice through enemies, and take their data to power up again! You only have a single shot! A challenge, a touch, a termination: A single graze from your enemies will delete you and force you to start each sector over again! The main objective is not the end: Replayability, with either keyboard, or gamepads! Make the most of your time and ability by reaching each sector, and finishing the game in the shortest time possible! Or perhaps, with as many chained combo attacks as possible!
row.short_description: Take the role of an antivirus software within the world of an operating system, eliminating malware spawns in a challenging, platforming quest!

row.name: Tray Racers!
row.detailed_description: ✨The world ended…But the fun didn’t!✨ From the creators of PHOGS!, Tray Racers! is a free-to-play racing game set in a vibrant post-apocalyptic world. Armed with nothing but your trusty tray, you play as a ragtag kid speedster - race solo or with up to 16 players through a wacky playground of randomly-generated sand dunes, cute critters, bouncy cactus forests and more! Surf the sizzling sands. Dazzle your pals with tray tricks. Hitch a ride on a giant worm. And outspeed your friends to become…the ultimate Tray Racer! For gamers of all ages! 💛 🌵 Hold onto your butts! It’s time to race… 🌵 Surf the dunes on your very own tray Race solo or in online multiplayer (with up to 16 players!!) Embrace your inner daredevil with *bonus speed* for near misses Goof off with silly emotes Pull off ✨cool ✨ tray tricks & combos Perfect for parties with pals 💛 🌵Discover a dazzling desert-world 🌵 When the world ended, the people of Tray Racers! found a better, more sustainable way to live. Together, and in better harmony with nature 🌱 Every race takes place on a unique, randomly-generated track - with weird and wonderful vistas, hazards, creatures, and surprises from a mix of bizarre & beautiful post-apocalyptic biomes. Featuring: Bouncy cactus forests Wacky wastelands Cute bugs & other critters Chaotic canyons Sustainable solarpunk settlements Herds of GIANT Camellos & More! 🎨 Race in style! Give your racer a makeover with…🎨 Sick Threads Gnarly Hairstyles Custom tray paint-jobs & More! 😊Get cute and cozy at the Camp 😊 Hang out with friends between races at the chilled-out Camp lobby Host a jam sesh with the Camp’s musical instruments Ponder your place in the universe under a starry night’s sky Pet *everything* with a dedicated ‘pet-the-thing’ button (There’s a friendly creature in the Camp called Scrump and we love him…) 🌱 Wholesome vibes 🌱 Made with 💛 by an indie team A positive take on the apocalypse that celebrates all things eco, kindness & community No way to hinder other players while racing (winning isn’t everything!) Characters that make you go awwwwwwww
row.short_description: The world ended…But the fun didn’t! Race solo, or with your pals across the adorable post-apocalyptic world of Tray Racers! Grab a tray, surf the dunes, and get ready to SLIDE, DRIFT and TRICK your way to the finish line in this cute and colorful party racer, built for online multiplayer! YAHOOOOOO!

row.name: The Moonlight Circus
row.detailed_description: In the Moonlight Circus , you wake up in the middle of an empty circus arena, with a syringe in your arm and the feeling of being watched. Who are you? What happened? And how do you get out of here? Take on the role of the protagonist and escape the Moonlight Circus. Unravel the mystery of the circus and its artists and get out alive. Features Explore three circus areas Movement through Arm Swinging Physics based gameplay Team The Crooked Creep Creators, a team of four students realized The Moonlight Circus with the help of one Sound student and two voice actors in three months as part of their studies at the h_da. Ben Wührer - Programmer, Game Designer, Sound Manager Lara Meyer - Vision Keeper, Character Artist, 2D/3D Artist Lea Wagner - Production Manager, 3D Artist, Animator Max Rupp - Tech / 3D Artist, Lighting Artist, Shading Artist Awesome Sound & Music from: Fabjén Rauch And the voices behind our characters: Andrew Latheron Will Edmisten The Moonlight Circus was made using Unity and FMOD. HTC Vive Users: If you use a vive you have to change the controller mappings, for example switch the menu button on both sides to left primary and right primary in the SteamVR settings. Example image is in the folder with the game files.
row.short_description: In this first-person VR-Horror game, you wake up in the middle of an empty circus arena, with a syringe in your arm and the feeling of being watched. Solve puzzles and discover clues to unveil the tragic backstory and find your way out.
row.notes: This game contains light patterns and flashing lights that may be harmful for certain individuals. It also contains graphic descriptions of suicide and violence which some viewers may find disturbing. Some general trigger warnings are as follows: loud noises, jumpscares, height, narrow spaces, drugs and syringes.

row.name: GHARP
row.detailed_description: Horanta Studio is a community that brings together those interested in game development. Horanta aims to ensure that game development activities are carried out in a way that contributes to social development based on national and spiritual feelings, to develop special projects and ideas for social problems, and to increase information sharing by creating a network among people interested in game development. Horanta organizes various online and face-to-face events to achieve this goal. GHARP is a first-person single-player story game that we developed as young members of Horanta Studio while learning game development. As a soldier, infiltrate a terrorist organization to prevent an act of terrorism. Take every opportunity to stop this terrorist organization that harms humanity and the world. Silently undermine the organization's moves throughout the operation. Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)
row.short_description: GHARP is a stealth-focused first person shooter game about sneaking into a terrorist organisation to prevent an attack.

row.name: Take the Throne
row.detailed_description: Join the Discord About the Game Take the Throne is a new Massive Multiplayer Online Battle Royale game with up to 25 players in a free-for-all bloody fight to be crowned and take the throne! Take the Throne is built on PvP encounters and is filled with comedic physics-based gameplay. FEATURES Official online battle royale servers with up to 25 players (regions in NA, EU) Create a private, locally hosted battle royale lobby in which friends can join via a code 7 Unique Classes, each with their own abilities 20+ Unique Maps Advanced fighting mechanics (3 different types of swings, as well as 2 class abilities for each class) Weapon hit force (the lower health you are, the further you get hit) Customize your character with 60+ skins (each with 4 different variations) and 100+ weapons (Some skins and weapons are only purchasable with crowns you get from winning the battle royale) Fully physics-based combat and incredibly funny ragdoll physics 25 PLAYER LOBBIES Take the Throne is a new Massive Multiplayer Online Battle Royale game with up to 25 players. Each round more players are eliminated until one player takes the throne! FUN FIGHTING MECHANICS Take the Throne combines ragdoll physics with advanced fighting mechanics and weapon hit force - where the lower health you are, the farther you get hit. SATISFYING PVP ENCOUNTERS Take the Throne is built on PvP encounters. Equip your weapon and have a choice at 3 different types of swings as well as unique class abilities! If you need to be on the defensive, use the block mechanic to avoid certain death! ENDLESS CUSTOMIZATION Take the Throne has thousands of skin/weapon combinations! Advancing further in the rounds/winning will allow you to purchase more skins or weapons.
row.short_description: Take the Throne is a massively multiplayer battle royale game with up to 25 players in a free-for-all bloody fight to be the last one alive.

row.name: Sex Search
row.detailed_description: Are you tired of a hard day at work? Or, on the contrary, do you want to strain your brains and make a test for the brain? Then this game is especially for you! The essence of the game is simple - you have an exorcism in front of you and you need to find 10 hidden items of clothing. The interest of the game also adds a variety of different game modes! Among which: 1) Normal Mode - here you can spend small gaming sessions as relaxed as possible. Select the level you are interested in and find 10 hidden items of clothing there. Found? Get the hottest image in the gallery as a reward! 2) Random Mode - here you can spend a lot of time. The level will be randomly selected and all items of clothing will be scattered randomly across the field. After passing the level, you immediately move to another with the same rules. 3) Time Attack Mode - this mode is a challenge for your attentiveness! Here, in 60 seconds, you will need to look for 10 hidden items of clothing at a random level. For each item found, you will receive +2 seconds to the timer. When finding all the items on the level - you are moved to the next one, saving your time. How long can you last? Game Features: 3 unique game modes 5 varied and desolate levels Unique system for placing items on levels The game is completely free
row.short_description: Plunge into the world of relaxation and light erotica! Mindfulness logic game with many modes.
row.notes: The game contains scenes of a sexual nature.

row.name: Elteria Hunter
row.detailed_description: Elteria Hunter The world of Elteria is a world full of magic and monsters, and it's a dangerous world for an average human. That's why the humans created a guild full of hunters to take down these monsters and keep peace in the world. But humans are not alone in this world. There are gods and demons too. In every region there is an Elder monster who controls the region and protects it from danger. But something strange is coming and even the Elders are acting up more dangerous than normal. So are you the new hunter that can protect us for what’s coming next? The primary focus in-game is following the story towards the stronger monsters. And with this, you will be mainly focused on crafting and quest to fight monsters and epic bosses. There will be a lot of different mechanics in the game to make your party very strong and make your own play style. In the early stage, the game will not be too hard, and it makes it easy to get the hang of the game, but after the mid-story, the game will get more complex, and you will need to have good gear, or else you will die. Buying This, you will receive the base game right now, going into early access, so the game will only grow towards his full release. The base game includes right now (more coming with future updates :D Story Quest. Side Quest. Dungeons. Craft system. Merchant system. Guild System.
row.short_description: The world of Elteria is full of magic and monsters, And the Elteria Hunters are there to fight these monsters and protect the regions from evil. Level up your skill grind for equipment and become the strongest hunter!

row.name: Zhijiang Town
row.detailed_description: 欢迎来到枝江小镇！ 你可以在这里和A-SOUL的小姐姐们互动 搭讪 要打成一片，首先你们需要互相认识 多聊聊天，这样才能增进感情 虽然只是街上一瞬的偶遇，但是缘分就是这样的，不要错过机会了 约会 ...终于搞好了关系，那么你们可以约定地点一起行动了 但是这个时候也不要太随意了，错误的行动会降低对方的好感 打工 唉，社交总是需要钱的 然而往好处想，人生什么地方又不需要花钱呢 你可以通过各种各样的兼职赚取金钱，然后用于购买礼物，或者作为约会的经费 ...有时候小姐姐对我的态度一直不亲热怎么办？有时候小姐姐只愿意和别人勾搭怎么办？ 别问了别问了，你到底是不是真心想要追求人家，来点耐心 顶不住了就睡大觉吧，第二天又是一条活龙了。 *本作是一部基于A-SOUL的二次创作同人游戏*
row.short_description: 你是然比，在架空的小镇上肆无忌惮地和妹子们玩耍（绝对清纯）

row.name: Xpraize Beta for GameMaster
row.detailed_description: Xpraize Beta, the first game developed by the indie game company RedefineArts Inc., is an innovative game that allows you to play a tabletop role-playing game in VR. The game is available in PC and VR versions, and in this PC versions, you are the Game Master. The Game Master will manage the game according to the prepared scenario. Switching stages, controlling NPC characters, and performing various event actions will be performed by the Game Master. Sometimes they become the player’s allies, and sometimes they control monsters to hunt the player down. Use the various camera control functions to record adventures to create your movie. Xpraize Beta includes an introductory fantasy scenario called “Dragon Descendants.” Up to 5 players can play online. All players except the game master will participate from VR. (If you only want to play as a player, you may not want to read the scenario for Game Master) We hope you will experience the fun of Xpraize through this scenario first. Scenario Book Overview Document Rulebook The additional scenario will be updated regularly after launch and available as DLC. The “Game Master” version is offered free of charge, so you can discuss it with your friends and decide who will be the Game Master before you play. Or you can go into the game as Game Master to recruit players to join you. Xpraize Beta
row.short_description: An innovative game to play a tabletop role-playing game in VR ! Let’s experience another side of RPGs. There are Game Master version and VR version. In this Game Master version, let's make VR players enjoy the game! You can also record players’ adventures like a movie director with various cameras.

row.name: 蓝星舰策略
row.detailed_description: Blue Star Ship strategy is a type of naval battle game which with operation and strategy, Our technical team makes these modern and contemporary famous warship models carefully, and use the three-dimensional technology to improve them. For restoring a real sea battlefield. Going on the Journey, player will play a supreme naval commander, recruiting soldiers, building the base and developing resources. You can build your own invincible warships to defend the territorial sea, fighting with enemy vehemently. Perfect and colorful cultivation system We imitate the real warships from the first world war, making our game models exactly the same as them. Each of warship or submarine has it own timeline and introduction. We also make all commander roles exactly according to different countries naval officers, decorating them with different costume and hair color, representing their countries vividly. Historical and classic battles Except experiencing the furious naval battle, It is really crucial that get ready for fight. Players can operate their own naval base, excavate lots of sea resources and arrange the line of defense. In short, you can use all of feasible strategy to develop and build your own military fortress to resist the all possibilities of being invaded. A kaleidoscopic battlefield strategy The naval war is not the simple and aimless military strength contest. In Blue Star Ship strategy, the one who can use reasonable stratagem will finally overcame the strong enemy. Matching the arm of the services in different solution, selecting the batter commander to fight with enemy. “Map out a strategy ahead of schedule, gain a decisive victory a thousand miles away”. In a word, using all strategy you come up with to win! Perfectly restore the real battlefield Last but not least, In Blue Star Ship strategy, you also have the opportunities to back to the past, enjoying in real classic naval battles, Facing the crisis situation in that war era. And learn about the choice they chose to change their countries destiny as well as their thought of training and commanding military. All in all, you can continue maintain the real history or create new naval history in Journey!
row.short_description: In a certain sea area in the future, when your fleet is invincible, you will praise yourself for discovering this game!
developers: 无锡上宸信息科技有限公司
publishers: 无锡上宸信息科技有限公司

row.name: SpectrumGames
row.detailed_description: SpectrumGames with Mafia Room is a platform for Mafia for 9 people, consisting of: three Citizens, a Special Officer, a Doctor, a Detective, three Mafia members. It is a team game (team of the peaceful city against the mafia team), which requires a leader from among the users. The goal of the mafia: to stay in equal numbers against the non-shooting peaceful roles. The goal of the peaceful city: to get the entire mafia out from behind the game table. How it happens: - The peaceful players analyze the players' statements during the day, the voting process, the results of the night's actions, and try to determine who plays for the mafia, and then take those players out from the game table. By voting, and by the city's firing roles, also by night actions. - Players playing for the Mafia try to take out as many peaceful players as possible by night actions and by voting. Sometimes set up their 'weakest link' in order to remove suspicion and gain a foothold at the game table. - By removing from the table a peaceful role that has the ability to take night actions, the Mafia gains a strategic advantage. - Players leaving the game table reveal their roles. - The game ends with a victory for the mafia when there are as many mafia players left at the table as there are peaceful players with a non-shooting role. Draw when the table remains 1 mafia and 1 firing peaceful role. In other cases - the victory of the peaceful city. - At the game table there is a set of ethical rules (no profanity, etc.) at the discretion of the host. What you can do in SpectrumGames: 1. Choose an avatar from ready-made avatars or generate an avatar from a photo and customize it. You can create any number of avatars, customize them and choose a new image for each game. 2. use emoji and gestures in addition to voice and text chat (we will increase the arsenal of emotions). 3. Interact with the environment. You can move some objects, move around the room (with the presenter's permission, of course). Possibilities for the Game Master: to upload his files (pdf, audio and 3D objects), create a closed or open room for the game with the subsequent invitation of players to it, moderate the game. Mafia is possibly the best team discussion game for boosting communication skills. It may be used for corporate team-building events and friendly parties. In our application, the Game Master can brand the space and build the game atmosphere like in real life!
row.short_description: The good old Mafia in a virtual space, as close to the offline version. Become the Game Master, invite players and build the game atmosphere as in real life! Or find an open room to join as a player.

row.name: Vamps For The Memories
row.detailed_description: An undead lord is terrorizing the countryside and every hunter in the realm is clamoring to be the first to stake'm! Play as two hunters who band together in their quest to defeat the new evil first! This is a cozy 90s JRPG style game where finding topics to banter about is a key to survival and trading stories of past battles gets you new and powerful skills. It's a lot of jokes, think a LucasArts Adventure teamed up with a Final Fantasy clone. Turn based combat, trading games, dungeon puzzles (e.g. box pushing) and lot of be people to talk to and banter topics to collect. There are options in the game to make combat easy and to give hints for the puzzles. You can turn them on and off anytime. This game was made in a few weeks for my DnD group and now it's out here for anyone who might enjoy it! Soundtrack: Resources: RPGMaker MZ Base Sprites and tiles from Additional sprites from @hazeldaydreamer (Check out ) Plugins from
row.short_description: Banter or die! Play two hunters who are racing to kill a vampire in a 90s JRPG style comedy. Solve puzzles, kill rats, and tolerate puns. It's like classic LucasArts made a Final Fantasy knock-off. The key to survival is exploring the world and finding things to talk about!

row.name: Siren's Call: Free Beta Edition
row.detailed_description: Disclaimer: This is a free, public beta for Siren's Call: Escape Velocity. Be forewarned. Siren’s Call, Florida, 2011, 60 miles north of Cape Kennedy The final days of your adolescence are coming to a close… Having solved the strange and terrifying mysteries of this quiet beach town, you have finally found the time to relax with your friends. In the two weeks since your adventure ended, the six of you have mostly cherished your time together—your spirits wafting beautifully on the precipice of adulthood. Even so, all good things must end. With only one day left in Siren’s Call, all that’s remains is for you to pack your bags and say goodbye to them. Don’t leave without making sure they know how you really feel. Only then can you finally be satisfied with what’s to come. Judith , the exceptionally sweet (and extraordinarily intense) sovereign of Siren’s Call; Andi , the sovereign’s sassy twin sister whose strength and spunk speak volumes on their own; Ashton , a hero in training whose sizable fist is matched only by the size of his heart; Emil , the once timid boy turned man who will not stop until he reaches absolute perfection; and Violet , waiting patiently as always. There's a couple others too...I guess. 7+ hours of Visual Novel Gameplay with dire consequences for how you choose to spend this final day of yours. 55 journal entries and and 60 unlockable gallery images for those who want to explore everything this town has to offer. An original story centered on saying goodbye to friends rather than saying hello to strangers. A dynamic, evocative soundtrack made by The Pocket Protectors and LilyxJorge meant to perfectly capture the feel of central Florida music. A cast of lovely characters that only want what's best for you. Developer Note: This is the free beta version of Siren's Call: Escape Velocity, meaning that compared to the full release, there will be missing content and bugs that have been patched by the time the full release is out. While this version is (and will always be) free/up on Steam, it is a much more janky experience compared to the finish product. Regardless, it is still a great look into the past of this project that I hope you enjoy!
row.short_description: This is an outdated, public beta for Siren's Call: Escape Velocity. Home is where your body is. And like any good tourist trap, Siren’s Call will do whatever it can to keep you there as long as possible. They will drag you down like crabs in a bucket. They will make this place home.
row.notes: emotional shutdowns and/or meltdowns relating to an autism spectrum disorder, epileptic seizures/life with epilepsy, depression and suicide, self-harm, physical and emotional abuse, sexual assault, unconsented exposure to drugs

row.name: Divine Combat
row.detailed_description: Divine Combat is a turn-based strategy game wherein you lead a team to victory against another team. Each team is led by a 'Divine', or a being of immense power. Your goal is to win every battle and get the perfect team. In the main hub, walk around in 3rd person and talk to NPCs. You can also upgrade your units and purchase items from the shop in the hub level. In the combat zone, you will have a team of 6 characters and will fight an enemy team to the death in a top-down grid view. All units will automatically find the best path to a location, so you will not have to manually plan moving out each unit, they will do it automatically.
row.short_description: Divine Combat is a turn-based strategy game wherein you lead a team to victory against another team. The fights are in top-down view on a grid, much like similar turn-based unit management games. There is no penalty for losing.

row.name: Day of the Dino
row.detailed_description: Photosensitivity Warning This game contains flashing lights and visual effects that may trigger seizures for players with photosensitive epilepsy. Discontinue if you experience dizziness or discomfort. Play in a well-lit room and take regular breaks. About the Game Welcome To The Trenches Uncover Mysteries Survive  Explore Key Features Economy System. Procedurally Generated Systems. First Person Gameplay. Truely Player-Driven.
row.short_description: Stranded alone, use your skills to uncover the mysteries on this Prehistoric Outbreak.
row.notes: Blood and weapons with the intent to do harm.

row.name: Bionic Rebirth
row.detailed_description: You are a man who was once known as 'August', now only an experiment in a science facility that converts humans into AI killing machines. You wake up in the perfect time, as a rogue AI has risen to power and taken over the facility. Fight your way through the floors and find a way to escape or even stop the AI... Explore the facility Gather upgrades Equip yourself with fate and a trusty gun Fight your way through the maze Defeat evil weaponized droids Drodge the deadliest lasers Do you have what it takes to shut down the facility and escape?
row.short_description: Classic arcade first person shooter, survive the depths of a overrun facility controlled by power AI. Can you escape?

row.name: Secrets of the Temple
row.detailed_description: You are a world-renowned treasure hunter seeking the ‘Eye of Ra’, a legendary diamond thought lost to the sands of time. The Eye is said to bring wealth and prosperity to any who possess it. Brave the Winding Tunnels of an Expansive Complex Navigate the shifting platforms, treacherous pitfalls, and fiendish traps left to guard the Eye in this ancient tomb. Solve Long-Forgotten Puzzles Pit your mind against the Pharaoh’s engineers and find ways of bypassing their locks and traps. Unearth Ancient Foes Fight for your life against the Pharaoh's undying chosen, sworn to guard the Eye long after the end of their natural lives.
row.short_description: Secrets of the Temple is a single player puzzle platformer adventure game. Traverse the Pharaoh's labyrinthian temple and locate and collect the Eye of Ra before it's too late!

row.name: Hohenheim: Skywards
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Hohenheim: Skywards Fly high into the skyes and hope not to fall to the below as the Underbelly is ready to swollow you whole. A 3rd-person Plattformer with environmental puzzle and Randomly generated Maps. Jump, take leaps of faith and follow the light. Battle challening Bosses and enemies (at some point) and soar the sky.... if you fall you enter the 2. dungeon in the form of the Underbelly and have to find a way out of the maze(at some point) before you can try again to soar thru the sky again and reach the city of Hohenheim. This game is free and born out of passion so dont expect a perfectely polished game :) it is and will always be free and a sideproject of mine and any kind of monitization will not take place. I swear so on my mothers grave as soon as she has one.... Either way...we getting side tracked... Enjoy the game.
row.short_description: Welcome to Hohenheim: Skywards Fly high into the skyes and hope not to fall to the below as the Underbelly is ready to swollow you whole. A 3rd-person Plattformer with environmental puzzle and Randomly generated Maps.

row.name: Slider
row.detailed_description: Slider is an award-winning puzzle adventure game where the world faces cataclysm , and you must use The Artifact to solve puzzles, rearrange maps, help reconnect humanity, and, most importantly... find your cat. Free to play! 10+ hours of content. Solve tricky puzzles with a variety of mechanics. Explore 9 unique regions, each with their own twists. Cats!!! Slide Tiles to Solve Puzzles Use The Artifact to slide pieces of the world to your advantage, unlocking treasures and completing each area's grid. Watch as your collection of objects expands as you solve increasingly complex puzzles. Explore 9 Unique Areas The world is full of mysteries, with each new area presenting a unique twist on the 8-puzzle. Discover rotating environments, tactical combat, 3D grids, time travel, and more! Help an Odd Cast of Characters After the world has been shattered, it's up to you to reconnect everyone. Help those in need piece their lives back together. Master Unique Mechanics Solve puzzles of increasing complexity as your toolbox grows and mechanics build upon each other. From anchors to minecarts to buoys to lights, take control of the world around you.
row.short_description: Slide chunks of the world to solve puzzles and help others. Control an ever-growing set of tiles and mechanics. Explore nine unique areas, unravel the mysteries of the universe, and reconnect the world -- one slider at a time.
row.reviews: “I cannot fathom why this is free” Buried Treasure “Charmingly absurd in every way... easily one of my favourite games of this whole year” Thinky Games

row.name: The Doll Beneath
row.detailed_description: Awakened from a deep slumber, six students find themselves trapped inside an abandoned research facility, otherwise known as the 'Losinglight'. Delve deep into the trenches of the black eclipse, and search for a way out. Escape into a war torn city, and discover the truth behind an otherworldly being like no other. KEY FEATURES A thrilling 5 episode long storyline. - Spanning over the course of five different episodes, with four chapters each, experience a different story with each entry. (Not all episodes may be available at launch.) Unique characters, all with their own individual backstories. - Each and every character has their own story to tell. Learn about them, and unravel the reason why you were taken. Detective-like gameplay, with numerous different ways to uncover the story. - Collect evidence, and piece the story together yourself. There's a bigger picture at play here, can you uncover the truth? A 2D classic RPG Maker horror experience. - Taking elements from other RPG Maker games, The Doll Beneath will combine the use the puzzles, exploration, and isolation, to bring you a one of a kind, classic RPG Maker experience. Discover secrets - Alongside the main story, comes a whole slew of side activities to discover. They're not easy to find. Run, hide, RUN! - Be wary, you're not alone in here. Run, hide, and most importantly, RUN, to stay alive! As you explore the world of Kemden City, you will encounter many different obstacles, some not even human. Do your best, and stay alive. Uncover the truth behind it all, and search for a way out.
row.short_description: Awakened from a deep slumber, six students find themselves trapped inside an abandoned research facility, otherwise known as the 'Losinglight'. Escape into a war torn city, and discover the truth behind an otherworldly being like no other.
row.notes: Slight violence and blood depicted.

row.name: Astral Slider
row.detailed_description: Astral Slider is an immersive time-attack laser racer. Slide through a number of different astral cyberworlds and blast your way past obstacles to increase your speed and beat your top scores. Features Play flatscreen or in VR (note: currently Oculus only) 100% free. No microtransactions here. Fast-paced gameplay. Avoid the black blocks and shoot the red ones to gain speed. Improve your times to earn up to three stars for each level. An exciting soundtrack that will get your heart pumping.
row.short_description: Astral Slider is an immersive time-attack laser racer. Slide through a number of different astral cyberworlds and blast your way past obstacles to increase your speed and beat your top scores. Play flatscreen or in VR.

row.name: Harriet: From Slave To Hero
row.detailed_description: Play as Harriet Tubman! , You will get to know the life of this incredible woman. From the years she was a slave to her famous rescue missions and her escape from slavery, you will travel throughout the most relevant moments of her life. You will progress through the highlights of her life, from escaping slavery to helping rescue other black slaves. Turn-based system where the player makes a move and enemies move after the player's turn ends Delve into 3 stages of his life and more than 25 different scenarios. Re-discover the life of Harriet Tubman through a board game experience. Stealth, action, and logic mechanics that will surprise you A beautiful soundtrack that accompanies each scenario
row.short_description: Harriet: From Slave to Hero is based on the life of Harriet Tubman, an African-American slave who would become the most famous fighter for the freedom of American slaves, in the years before the American Civil War. It is a 2.5 D turn-based strategy game with puzzle and stealth components.

row.name: Lights Off!
row.detailed_description: Lights off is a short and experimental horror game. Play through a fear most of us have experienced as you turn off the lights alone at home.
row.short_description: Play through a common childhood fear about turning the lights off and going to bed.

row.name: Catharsis
row.detailed_description: Catharsis is a character driven dungeon diver where the goal is to explore maze-like environments to collect treasure and return to town alive. Players have control over their character’s classes and gear, and must manage their inventory space as they explore the dungeons and face powerful monsters and ancient horrors. The player characters are a party of Lost Souls that need to venture deeper into the dungeon to defeat the Ancient Horror preventing their rebirth. Strengthen the souls and equipment of your characters and challenge the 3 increasingly grim dungeons against monsters with class archetypes, unique skills and dangers.
row.short_description: Descend deep in the dungeons of Catharsis to reclaim what you've lost. Dive into this First Person Dungeon Crawler featuring a grim aesthetic with a heavy focus on character growth, exploration and customization!

row.name: 索罗灵魂之戒
row.detailed_description: 【更多资讯】 1.欢迎加入Q群获取最新消息 2.索罗灵魂之戒（体验版）本版本只能体验第一章。如需体验完整版。需要安装新增剧情DLC.可联系作者折扣购买DLC 作者群号：1083308037（有攻略礼包，推荐加入）[/h2] 游戏介绍 这是斯坦因大陆。充满着奇幻色彩，由于能量风暴。空间壁障破裂 很多穿越的人(狗群员)都到达这个大陆。。。 我叫索罗，我是一个魔法师。到处充满了我的传说 因为~~~~我站在了斯坦因大陆的顶端就差一步就成神了。 可是我最爱的莉莉丝她自己为了成神背叛了我。躯体被毁。灵魂藏匿在戒指之中。 之后苟延残喘。为了变强不得不用了禁术。变成过史莱姆。吞噬过魅魔 附身过萌妹子........... 传统回合制RPG游戏，拥有沙雕，逗比，解密，懵逼反转的剧情。附身，变化。皮物的快乐幻想.让你快乐拥有各种后宫。 奇奇怪怪的技能，一脸问号的怪物让你体会不一样的放开自我的RPG. 在经历过生死考验。和困难的关卡玩法之后，能够获得不一样的老婆和妹子。 一脸懵逼的超高死亡率。让你挑战不一样的奇幻冒险。 推荐低血压，锻炼心态。强大的灵魂人类玩耍。弱小的人类请勿游玩。直接想脱裤子，无敌爽游者慎入！ 游戏元素 回合制RPG要素。属性克制。 法术融合。魅魔，附身，融合，变身。 搞笑，热梗的游戏故事。 奇奇怪怪的装备系统。 通过附身获得不一样的能力。 邂逅更多的美少女。 精致的游戏地图。 长时间的游戏时间。
row.short_description: 十分解压的游戏。拥有各种附身，变身，皮物等福利和梦幻技能。让你享受到不一样的快乐RPG。 许多网络热梗。让你快乐的同时紧跟时事。

row.name: Riki's Risky Ride
row.detailed_description: Reach the top of the city Riki's Risky Ride is a car-platformer, in which you car can drive upside down. That means you can not crash, but do not fall down, as every fall can set you back significantly. Spin to make sure you land the way you need to Thrust to gain that little bit of extra distance Take on any obstacle no matter how steep or difficult they may be Features Singleplayer Car that can drive upside down and has incredible grip Stylized artstyle Lose your progress, again and again Feeling of accomplishment when or rather if you reach the top of the city Music by Jonathan Reed
row.short_description: Riki’s Risky Ride is a challenging 2.5D Platformer. Drive, spin, jump your car to reach the top of the city.

row.name: Path Of Destruction
row.detailed_description: Get out of your base, get out of the comfort zone. Face other opponents inside a unknow labyrinth. Follow the path to nowhere or destroy the walls to give a end for your enemies. Path of Destruction is a round based game, every round you have a opportunity to purchase and sell items before going to the action. Move around gathering items, exploding dynamites, throwing grenades or just shot at the wall, the rule is never stand in the same place. Adquire powerful weapons and bring destruction to the game. We have a few available weapons now: - Glock (Pistol) | Ak47 (Rifle) | M4A1 (Rifle) | MP249 (Heavy Machine Gun) | Katana (Melee) | Baseball Bet (Melee) Create new strategies to get ahead of your enemies Use your resource wisely, don't open a new passage on the labyrinth with explosives if it doesn't lead to new items/resources. Find out combinations of specials (those can be purchased on the shop), you could leave specific items on the map and place mines near it so other players may will fall down. Face not only players but also other environment enemies. There are two times of AI enemies: - Walking [Blue Aliens] | Static [Turrets] Fool your friends with fake items. You can have 3 different specials at the same time, each special can be used two times (once an upgrade is bought). There are a few types of specials in the game right now: - Back To Base | Fake Item | Cluster Bomb | Pain Reflection | Master Key | Ghost | Invisible Bullets | Remote Controlled Bomb | First Aid Kit | Projectiles Ignore Walls | Missile Attack | Brightness | Bomber
row.short_description: Face other opponents inside a unknow labyrinth. Follow the path to no where or destroy the walls to give a end for your enemies. Path of Destruction is a top-down 2D multiplayer PVP focused game.

row.name: The World is Binary: Why Love is the Answer
row.detailed_description: The World is Binary, a 3D visual novel, takes you on a journey of good and evil, science and religion, and questions what is true or false. The experience explores the ideas of love and fear, and offers practical steps on how you can improve your life and change the world. Essentially a multimedia book, the experience lasts about 30 minutes and explores many serious and deep issues, such as the ideological differences between people of faith and the scientific community, the people's freedom and the government's order, and explores how the emotions of love and fear hold a deeper meaning in life. There are no choices or branching. It is, in essence, a book. However there are real time 3D graphics running in the background, and relaxing music to listen to as you read. The graphics are configurable for both high-end and low-end machines, and you can hide the text and just watch the experience as a looping benchmark. Press Alt + Enter for Full Screen mode. Press Space to Toggle Text. Press Escape to Access Options.
row.short_description: The World is Binary, a 3D visual novel, takes you on a journey of good and evil, science and religion, and questions what is true or false. The experience explores the ideas of love and fear, and offers practical steps on how you can improve your life and change the world.
